taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: current-steering, wide-swing cascoded 2:1 mirrors
* iref sinks 25uA from bench; UP sources +50uA into vout, DN sinks -50uA.
* Sky130 MOS syntax:
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ---------------- bias core ----------------
* nbias is the iref pin itself; enclosing-cascode NMOS diode (25uA unit)
* forces the diode unit to the same vds as the output mirrors
XMN1  a1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=144 nf=24 m=1
XMN1C iref ncasc a1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=24 nf=4 m=1
* pcasc generator: half-unit NMOS pulls 12.5uA through small P diode
XMNB  pcasc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=72 nf=12 m=1
XMPCG pcasc pcasc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=7 nf=1 m=1
* ncasc generator: half-unit PMOS sources 12.5uA into small N diode
XMPC  ncasc pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6 w=144 nf=24 m=1
XMNCG ncasc ncasc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=4.3 nf=1 m=1
* startup leaker: forces ncasc alive, kills the all-off state
XMLK  ncasc vss vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=0.42 nf=1 m=1

* ------------- transfer branch (50uA) -------------
* NMOS mirror + cascode into enclosing-cascode PMOS diode -> pbias
XMNT  t1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=144 nf=24 m=2
XMNTC pbias ncasc t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=24 nf=4 m=2
XMPDC pbias pcasc p1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=48 nf=8 m=2
XMPD  p1 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6 w=288 nf=48 m=2

* ------------- UP output branch (50uA source) -------------
XMPU  pu1 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6 w=288 nf=48 m=2
XMPUC pu2 pcasc pu1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=48 nf=8 m=2
* steering pair: on/off switches identical so pu2 barely moves on handoff
* (on-switch gate=upb to vout; off-switch gate=upt dumps to vss)
XMPSON vout upb pu2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=16 nf=4 m=1
XMPSOF vss  upt pu2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=16 nf=4 m=1

* ------------- DN output branch (50uA sink) -------------
XMND  nd1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=144 nf=24 m=2
XMNDC nd2 ncasc nd1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=24 nf=4 m=2
* steering pair: on-switch to vout (gate=dnt, fast buffered), off-switch dumps to vdd
XMNSON vout dnt nd2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2 m=1
XMNSOF vdd  dnb nd2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1 m=1

* ------------- control buffers -------------
* strong single-stage inverter (fall-skewed) drives the UP on-switch gate
XI1P upb up  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2 m=1
XI1N upb up  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2 m=1
XI2P upt upb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1 m=1
XI2N upt upb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
* two-stage fast buffer for the DN on-switch gate (true polarity)
XI3P dnb dn  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2 m=1
XI3N dnb dn  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=1
XI4P dnt dnb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=2 m=1
XI4N dnt dnb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2 m=1

* ------------- bias stiffening -------------
CB1 iref  vss 2p
CB2 pbias vdd 2p
CB3 ncasc vss 0.8p
CB4 pcasc vdd 0.8p

.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump, current steering, 50uA matched UP/DN from 25uA reference.
* Architecture:
*   - iref pin terminates in a wide-swing cascode NMOS master (gate at iref).
*   - Wide-swing cascode mirrors on both rails; mirror-device Vds is set by
*     the same cascode bias in master and slaves, so ratios track over PVT.
*   - 12.5uA unit devices instantiated as parallel X units so each carries an
*     independent local-mismatch draw (correct area averaging).
*   - Output branches steer continuously between vout and a clamped dump node
*     vd, so internal nodes stay biased and switching is fast.
* Unit currents: every mirror unit runs at 12.5uA. UP/DN outputs use 4 units.

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

*----------------------------------------------------------------
* NMOS reference input: wide-swing master, gate ties to iref (top)
*----------------------------------------------------------------
XMDN1 n0 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=48 nf=4
XMDN2 n0 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=48 nf=4
XCN01 iref nb2 n0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=2
XCN02 iref nb2 n0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=2

*----------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias generators (feed-forward, self-starting)
* A4: 12.5uA into narrow PMOS diode -> pb2 (PMOS cascode gate bias)
* A5 -> crude P mirror -> narrow NMOS diode -> nb2 (NMOS cascode gate bias)
*----------------------------------------------------------------
XA4 pb2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=48 nf=4
XMPB2 pb2 pb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=32 nf=2
XA5 bpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=48 nf=4
XBPC bpc bpc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=160 nf=8
XPB2C nb2 bpc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=160 nf=8
XMNB2 nb2 nb2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=8 nf=1

*----------------------------------------------------------------
* S2: cascoded NMOS slave (25uA) feeding the PMOS master input
*----------------------------------------------------------------
XS21 ns2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=48 nf=4
XS22 ns2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=48 nf=4
XCS21 pb1 nb2 ns2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=2
XCS22 pb1 nb2 ns2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=2

*----------------------------------------------------------------
* PMOS master: wide-swing input cell, gate ties to pb1 (bottom of CP0)
*----------------------------------------------------------------
XMDP1 pd0 pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=160 nf=8
XMDP2 pd0 pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=160 nf=8
XCP01 pb1 pb2 pd0 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=4
XCP02 pb1 pb2 pd0 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=4

*----------------------------------------------------------------
* DN output branch: 50uA cascoded sink + steering switches
*----------------------------------------------------------------
XMND1 ns iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=48 nf=4
XMND2 ns iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=48 nf=4
XMND3 ns iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=48 nf=4
XMND4 ns iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=48 nf=4
XMCD1 nx nb2 ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=2
XMCD2 nx nb2 ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=2
XMCD3 nx nb2 ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=2
XMCD4 nx nb2 ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=2
XSWDO vout dg2 nx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2
XSWDD vd dg1 nx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2

*----------------------------------------------------------------
* UP output branch: 50uA cascoded source + steering switches
*----------------------------------------------------------------
XMPU1 ps pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=160 nf=8
XMPU2 ps pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=160 nf=8
XMPU3 ps pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=160 nf=8
XMPU4 ps pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=160 nf=8
XMCU1 px pb2 ps vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=4
XMCU2 px pb2 ps vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=4
XMCU3 px pb2 ps vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=4
XMCU4 px pb2 ps vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=4
XSWUO vout ug1 px vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=2
XSWUD vd ug2 px vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=2

*----------------------------------------------------------------
* Dump-node clamps: absorb/supply steered current, keep vd mid-rail
*----------------------------------------------------------------
XCLN vd vd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XCLP vd vd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=96 nf=8

*----------------------------------------------------------------
* Gate drivers.  UP out-switch: 1 stage.  UP dump: 2 stages.
*                DN dump: 1 stage.       DN out-switch: 2 stages.
*----------------------------------------------------------------
XIU1P ug1 up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64 nf=4
XIU1N ug1 up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=2
XIU2P ug2 ug1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=48 nf=4
XIU2N ug2 ug1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=2
XID1P dg1 dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=2
XID1N dg1 dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2
XID2P dg2 dg1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=2
XID2N dg2 dg1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2

*----------------------------------------------------------------
* Ideal caps: bias filtering / node stiffening
*----------------------------------------------------------------
CB1 iref vss 10p
CB2 nb2 vss 2p
CB3 pb1 vdd 10p
CB4 pb2 vdd 2p
CVD vd vss 2p

.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* Current-steering PLL charge pump (SKY130), 50 uA UP / 50 uA DN from a 25 uA iref.
*
* - iref sinks into a wide-swing (low-voltage) cascoded NMOS diode (XNR/XNCR).
*   Long, wide mirror devices (l=8) keep local Vth mismatch small; the reference
*   and output mirrors see the same cascode-defined Vds, so UP/DN track over PVT.
* - An NMOS copy (XNP/XNCP) feeds the wide-swing cascoded PMOS diode (XPR/XPCR)
*   that biases the UP source.
* - Cascode gate biases are feed-forward from iref (iref -> vcp -> vcn), so the
*   bias loop has no zero-current equilibrium and the DC operating point
*   converges robustly.
* - UP/DN currents are always flowing and are steered between vout and vdum.
*   A PMOS-input unity-gain buffer holds vdum at vout so the source/sink
*   internal nodes (pp/nn) do not jump when the current is steered.
* - Each output switch and its dummy switch are driven by 1- and 2-inverter
*   paths so switching is centred on the control-edge midpoint.
.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout
* NMOS reference (wide-swing cascode diode, 25 uA)
XNCR iref vcn zr vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=3
XNR zr iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=8
* NMOS copy (25 uA) feeding the PMOS reference
XNCP rp vcn zp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=3
XNP zp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=160 nf=8
* PMOS reference (wide-swing cascode diode, 25 uA)
XPCR rp vcp xr vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=150 nf=8
XPR xr rp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=480 nf=24
* DN sink, 50 uA (2x reference)
XNCD nn vcn zn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=5
XNDN zn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=320 nf=16
* UP source, 50 uA (2x reference; split to respect the model width bins)
XPCU pp vcp xu vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=300 nf=15
XPUP_0 xu rp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=480 nf=24
XPUP_1 xu rp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=480 nf=24
* Cascode gate bias: iref -> XNBP -> PMOS diode (vcp) -> XPBN -> NMOS diode (vcn)
XPBN vcn vcp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.12 nf=1
XNBN vcn vcn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.5 nf=1
XNBP vcp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=32 nf=2
XPBP vcp vcp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.4 nf=1
* Steering switches (output / dummy)
XPSO vout upb pp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
XPSD vdum upd pp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
XNSO vout dnd nn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XNSD vdum dnb nn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
* Control inverters: upb = !up, upd = up; dnb = !dn, dnd = dn
XIU1P upb up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1
XIU1N upb up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XID1P dnb dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
XID1N dnb dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XIU2P upd upb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XIU2N upd upb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XID2P dnd dnb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XID2N dnd dnb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* Dummy-node buffer: PMOS-input OTA, NMOS pull-down, 60 uA PMOS pull-up
XBT bt rp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=192 nf=10
XBI1 b1 vdum bt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4 nf=1
XBI2 b2 vout bt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4 nf=1
XBL1 b1 b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XBL2 b2 b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XBO vdum b2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XBS_0 vdum rp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=576 nf=29
XBS_1 vdum rp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=576 nf=29
* Buffer Miller compensation and dummy-node stiffening
CBC vdum b2 1e-12
CDM vdum vss 4e-12
* Bias decoupling
CBN iref vss 1e-12
CBP rp vdd 1e-12
CCN vcn vss 1e-12
CCP vcp vdd 1e-12
.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: current-steering switches, wide-swing cascoded mirrors.
* 25 uA reference (sunk at iref) -> +50 uA UP source, -50 uA DN sink.
* Idle currents are steered into a shared dump node held at vout by a
* unity-gain OTA, so the steering nodes na/nb do not move when switching.
* Long-L mirror devices (W*L of 1000-7200 um^2) set the local-mismatch spread;
* ad/as/pd/ps model source/drain junctions (xschem-style, 0.29 um diffusion).

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout
* ---- NMOS reference mirror (wide-swing cascode, gate taken at iref) ----
XM0    nx0  iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=100 nf=10 ad=14.5 as=17.4 pd=102.9 ps=123.5
XMC0   iref vbn  nx0  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2 ad=2.9 as=5.8 pd=20.58 ps=41.16
* DN sink (2x)
XMND   nxd  iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=200 nf=20 ad=29 as=31.9 pd=205.8 ps=226.4
XMCD   nb   vbn  nxd  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4 ad=5.8 as=8.7 pd=41.16 ps=61.74
* NMOS sink feeding the PMOS reference (1x)
XMNP   nxp  iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=100 nf=10 ad=14.5 as=17.4 pd=102.9 ps=123.5
XMCP   pref vbn  nxp  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2 ad=2.9 as=5.8 pd=20.58 ps=41.16

* ---- PMOS reference mirror (wide-swing cascode, gate taken at pref) ----
XMP0   px0  pref vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=10 w=360 nf=20 ad=52.2 as=57.42 pd=365.8 ps=402.4
XMPC0  pref vbp  px0  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4 ad=5.8 as=8.7 pd=41.16 ps=61.74
* UP source (2x)
XMPU   pxu  pref vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=10 w=720 nf=40 ad=104.4 as=109.6 pd=731.6 ps=768.2
XMPCU  na   vbp  pxu  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=8 ad=11.6 as=14.5 pd=82.32 ps=102.9

* ---- cascode bias generation ----
XMNB1  vbp  iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=20 nf=2 ad=2.9 as=5.8 pd=20.58 ps=41.16
XMBP   vbp  vbp  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.7 w=2.6 nf=1 ad=0.754 as=0.754 pd=5.78 ps=5.78
XMPB2  vbn  vbp  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.7 w=2.6 nf=1 ad=0.754 as=0.754 pd=5.78 ps=5.78
XMBN   vbn  vbn  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=0.8 nf=1 ad=0.232 as=0.232 pd=2.18 ps=2.18

* ---- steering switches (output and dump switches matched) ----
XSWOP  vout upb  na   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4 ad=1.16 as=1.74 pd=9.16 ps=13.74
XSWDP  dmp  upd  na   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4 ad=1.16 as=1.74 pd=9.16 ps=13.74
XSWON  vout dnd  nb   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2 ad=0.58 as=1.16 pd=4.58 ps=9.16
XSWDN  dmp  dnb  nb   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2 ad=0.58 as=1.16 pd=4.58 ps=9.16

* ---- dump-node follower: NMOS-input OTA, output = dmp = inverting input ----
* ~60 uA tail so it can absorb/supply a full 50 uA dump current in DC.
XMO1   od1  vout ot   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2 ad=1.45 as=2.9 pd=10.58 ps=21.16
XMO2   dmp  dmp  ot   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2 ad=1.45 as=2.9 pd=10.58 ps=21.16
XMOT   ot   iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=240 nf=24 ad=34.8 as=37.7 pd=247 ps=267.5
XMO3   od1  od1  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=4 ad=5.8 as=8.7 pd=41.16 ps=61.74
XMO4   dmp  od1  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=4 ad=5.8 as=8.7 pd=41.16 ps=61.74
* small pull-up so dmp fails high (switches stay off) if vout leaves OTA range

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: 50uA matched UP/DN, SKY130 1.8V core devices.
* Architecture:
*  - iref (25uA into pin) biases a wide-swing NMOS cascode mirror (super-diode:
*    mirror gate taken at the input-cascode drain so mirror Vds matches outputs).
*  - DN sink = 2x NMOS units + cascode. A second 2x NMOS branch feeds a PMOS
*    wide-swing super-diode, giving the 50uA UP source (1:1 PMOS mirror).
*  - Steering switches sit AFTER the output cascodes: turn-off is set by the
*    switch gate edge, off-state leakage is a hard-off switch at vout.
*  - Inactive branch current steers into per-branch dump rails clamped near
*    0.9V by LVT diode devices with ideal hold caps (allowed C usage).
*  - NOR-based non-overlap drive prevents vout<->dump crossbar current.

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ---------------- reference input branch (iref node = N mirror gate) --------
XNIC iref vcn nsi vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=12 nf=1
XNI0 nsi iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=90 nf=1

* ---------------- crude bias branches for cascode gate generation -----------
* half-unit NMOS mirrors (12.5uA), 1:1 PMOS crude mirror
XNB1 vbp0 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=22.5 nf=1
XPB0 vbp0 vbp0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=5 w=50 nf=1
XPB2 vcn vbp0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=5 w=50 nf=1
XNCG vcn vcn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=0.75 nf=1
XNB3 vcp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=22.5 nf=1
XPCG vcp vcp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2.6 nf=1

* ---------------- DN branch: 2x units + cascode -----------------------------
XND1 nsd iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=90 nf=1
XND2 nsd iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=90 nf=1
XNDC ydn vcn nsd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=24 nf=1

* ---------------- UP feed branch: 2x units + cascode into P super-diode -----
XNU1 nsu iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=90 nf=1
XNU2 nsu iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=90 nf=1
XNUC vbpg vcn nsu vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=24 nf=1

* ---------------- PMOS super-diode (50uA) and UP output branch --------------
XPI1 psi vbpg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=5 w=200 nf=1
XPI2 psi vbpg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=5 w=200 nf=1
XPIC vbpg vcp psi vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=48 nf=1
XPU1 psu vbpg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=5 w=200 nf=1
XPU2 psu vbpg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=5 w=200 nf=1
XPUC yup vcp psu vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=48 nf=1

* ---------------- steering switches (after cascodes) ------------------------
XSWU  vout a1u yup vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=16 nf=1
XSWUD vdmpu du yup vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=16 nf=1
XSWD  vout a2d ydn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1
XSWDD vdmpd dd ydn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1

* ---------------- dump rails: LVT diode clamps near 0.9V + hold caps --------
XDDP vdmpd vdmpd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XDUN vdmpu vdmpu vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=3.5 nf=1
CDD vdmpd vss 20p
CDU vdmpu vss 20p

* ---------------- control buffers -------------------------------------------
* UP: out switch gate = a1u; dump gate = INV(NOR(up,a2u)) for non-overlap
XIU1P a1u up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XIU1N a1u up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XIU2P a2u a1u vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XIU2N a2u a1u vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* NOR2(up,a2u) -> nu ; INV -> du
XUNP1 nu1 up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XUNP2 nu a2u nu1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XUNN1 nu up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XUNN2 nu a2u vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XUIP du nu vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
XUIN du nu vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* DN: out switch gate = a2d; dump gate = NOR(dn,a2d) for non-overlap
XID1P a1d dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XID1N a1d dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
XID2P a2d a1d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1
XID2N a2d a1d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XDNP1 nd1 dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XDNP2 dd a2d nd1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XDNN1 dd dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XDNN2 dd a2d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------- bias decoupling -------------------------------------------
CBN iref vss 5p
CBP vbpg vdd 5p
CCN vcn vss 3p
CCP vcp vdd 3p

.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump - 50 uA matched UP/DN, single 25 uA reference input
* Architecture:
*   - 25 uA sinks into a diode-connected NMOS reference (iref).
*   - A cascoded NMOS mirror copies 25 uA into an LVT PMOS reference
*     diode (vdd-referenced), so both bias polarities are current-driven.
*   - Cascoded 2x mirrors create the 50 uA UP (PMOS) and DN (NMOS)
*     sources.  Wide-swing cascode gates set the mirror drain voltages
*     to ~0.2 V, keeping the sources saturated with minimum headroom.
*   - The reference and transfer cascodes are scaled to half the mirror
*     current density and their drains are biased to the same voltage as
*     the output mirror drains, so the 2x ratio is geometric and its
*     temperature drift cancels.
*   - Current steering: each source always carries 50 uA; transmission
*     gates route it either to vout or to a dump load biased near the
*     vout operating point, so the steering node does not move between
*     on and off states (minimal displacement-charge error).
*   - Cascode gate biases come from ratioed diode-connected devices at
*     one quarter of the mirror current density.

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Reference: 25 uA NMOS diode; cascoded 1x copy transfers the current
* into the LVT PMOS reference diode.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMRN   xrn  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=4    w=80   nf=8
XMRNC  iref vcn  xrn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5  w=20   nf=1
XMNT   xt   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=4    w=80   nf=8
XMTC   xp   vcn  xt  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5  w=20   nf=1
XMPR   xrp  xp   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4    w=180  nf=16
XMPRC  xp   vcp  xrp  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4    w=240  nf=16

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* UP branch: 2x PMOS current source + cascode, steering node tup.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMPU   aup  xp   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4    w=360  nf=32
XMPC   tup  vcp  aup vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4    w=480  nf=32

* output transmission gate (on when up high)
XSPU   tup  upb  vout vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.55 w=15.7 nf=2
XSNU   tup  up   vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=10   nf=2

* dump transmission gate (on when up low)
XSDUP  tup  up   dup  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=20   nf=2
XSDUN  tup  upb  dup  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=10   nf=2

* dump load: NMOS diode near 0.9 V at 50 uA, low temperature drift
XDDUP  dup  dup  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=4    nf=1
CDUP   dup  vss  0.5p

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* DN branch: 2x NMOS current sink + cascode, steering node tdn.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMND   adn  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=4    w=160  nf=16
XMNC   tdn  vcn  adn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5  w=40   nf=1

* output transmission gate (on when dn high)
XSPD   tdn  dnb  vout vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.55 w=15.7 nf=2
XSND   tdn  dn   vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=10   nf=2

* dump transmission gate (on when dn low)
XSDDP  tdn  dn   ddn  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=20   nf=2
XSDDN  tdn  dnb  ddn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=10   nf=2

* dump load: fixed current source (mirrors xp) plus a small NMOS diode
* that sets ddn from the excess current; the diode voltage is nearly
* independent of vdd and has a small temperature coefficient.
XDDS   ddn  xp   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4    w=396  nf=16
XNDDN  ddn  ddn  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=0.75 nf=1
CDDN   ddn  vss  0.5p

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Wide-swing cascode gate bias.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMBP   vcn  xp   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4    w=180  nf=16
XMBN   vcn  vcn  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=1.9  nf=1

XMBPD  vcp  vcp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1    w=3.3  nf=1
XMBNS  vcp  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=4    w=40   nf=4

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Control inverters
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XINVP1 upb  up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=10   nf=1
XINVN1 upb  up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=5    nf=1
XINVP2 dnb  dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=10   nf=1
XINVN2 dnb  dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=5    nf=1

.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL Charge Pump - 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ===========================================================================
* 1. Acyclic Feed-Forward Bias Generation for Wide-Swing Cascodes
* ===========================================================================
* Step A: NMOS mirror from iref (12.5 uA = 0.5x of 25 uA) generates vb_pcas
XMN_B_PCAS vb_pcas iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=12.0 w=36.0 nf=1 m=2
* Self-biased PMOS triode-foot stack generating vb_pcas (~ VDD - 0.95 V)
XMP_BTRI p_btri vb_pcas vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4.0 w=16.0 nf=1 m=2
XMP_BCAS vb_pcas vb_pcas p_btri vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.0 nf=1 m=6

* Step B: Replica of PMOS bias stack (12.5 uA) generates vb_ncas
XMP_BTRI_REP p_btri_r vb_pcas vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4.0 w=16.0 nf=1 m=2
XMP_BCAS_REP vb_ncas vb_pcas p_btri_r vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.0 nf=1 m=6
* Self-biased NMOS triode-foot stack generating vb_ncas (~ 0.90 V)
XMN_BTRI n_btri vb_ncas vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8.0 w=8.0 nf=1 m=1
XMN_BCAS vb_ncas vb_ncas n_btri vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.0 nf=1 m=3

* ===========================================================================
* 2. Wide-Swing Cascoded NMOS Reference & Mirror (25 uA in -> 25 uA & 50 uA)
* ===========================================================================
* Reference branch (25 uA): 4 parallel large-area units (432 um^2 each)
XMN_REF1 ref_mid iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=12.0 w=36.0 nf=1 m=1
XMN_REF2 ref_mid iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=12.0 w=36.0 nf=1 m=1
XMN_REF3 ref_mid iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=12.0 w=36.0 nf=1 m=1
XMN_REF4 ref_mid iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=12.0 w=36.0 nf=1 m=1
XMN_REFCAS iref vb_ncas ref_mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.0 nf=1 m=6

* PMOS bias feeder branch (25 uA = 1x of iref)
XMN_PBIAS1 pbias_mid iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=12.0 w=36.0 nf=1 m=1
XMN_PBIAS2 pbias_mid iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=12.0 w=36.0 nf=1 m=1
XMN_PBIAS3 pbias_mid iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=12.0 w=36.0 nf=1 m=1
XMN_PBIAS4 pbias_mid iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=12.0 w=36.0 nf=1 m=1
XMN_PBIASCAS p_gate vb_ncas pbias_mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.0 nf=1 m=6

* DN output current sink branch (50 uA = 2x of iref)
XMN_CS1 dn_mid iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=12.0 w=36.0 nf=1 m=2
XMN_CS2 dn_mid iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=12.0 w=36.0 nf=1 m=2
XMN_CS3 dn_mid iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=12.0 w=36.0 nf=1 m=2
XMN_CS4 dn_mid iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=12.0 w=36.0 nf=1 m=2
XMN_CAS dn_cas vb_ncas dn_mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.0 nf=1 m=12

* ===========================================================================
* 3. Wide-Swing Cascoded PMOS Reference & Mirror (25 uA -> 50 uA)
* ===========================================================================
* PMOS reference branch (25 uA): 4 parallel large-area units (504 um^2 each)
XMP_REF1 pref_mid p_gate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6.0 w=84.0 nf=1 m=1
XMP_REF2 pref_mid p_gate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6.0 w=84.0 nf=1 m=1
XMP_REF3 pref_mid p_gate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6.0 w=84.0 nf=1 m=1
XMP_REF4 pref_mid p_gate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6.0 w=84.0 nf=1 m=1
XMP_REFCAS p_gate vb_pcas pref_mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.0 nf=1 m=12

* UP output current source branch (50 uA = 2x of p_gate)
XMP_CS1 up_mid p_gate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6.0 w=84.0 nf=1 m=2
XMP_CS2 up_mid p_gate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6.0 w=84.0 nf=1 m=2
XMP_CS3 up_mid p_gate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6.0 w=84.0 nf=1 m=2
XMP_CS4 up_mid p_gate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6.0 w=84.0 nf=1 m=2
XMP_CAS up_cas vb_pcas up_mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.0 nf=1 m=24

* ===========================================================================
* 4. High-Speed Current-Steering Switches & Deadband Mid-Rail Dummy Clamp
* ===========================================================================
* DN current-steering switches
XMN_SW vout dn dn_cas vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1 m=4
XMN_DUM v_dum dn_b dn_cas vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1 m=4

* UP current-steering switches (l=0.18 suppresses 125C off-state leakage)
XMP_SW vout up_b up_cas vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=2.0 nf=1 m=8
XMP_DUM v_dum up up_cas vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=2.0 nf=1 m=8

* Deadband push-pull clamp on shared dummy node v_dum (~0.9 V, zero shoot-through)
XMN_CLAMP vdd p_btri v_dum vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=2.0 nf=1 m=4
XMP_CLAMP vss n_btri v_dum vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=2.0 nf=1 m=8

* Inverters for complementary switch signals
XMP_INV_UP up_b up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=3.5 nf=1 m=2
XMN_INV_UP up_b up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1 m=2

XMP_INV_DN dn_b dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=2.0 nf=1 m=2
XMN_INV_DN dn_b dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1 m=2

* ===========================================================================
* 5. Internal Bias Stiffening Capacitors
* ===========================================================================
C_NREF iref vss 10p
C_PREF p_gate vdd 10p
C_NCAS vb_ncas vss 10p
C_PCAS vb_pcas vdd 10p
C_BTRIN n_btri vss 10p
C_BTRIP p_btri vdd 10p
C_DUM v_dum vss 20p

.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump - current-steering, 25uA reference, +/-50uA output
* UP sources current into vout (up=1), DN sinks current from vout (dn=1).
* All devices are SKY130 1.8V core MOS. Ideal capacitors only.

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* NMOS self-cascoded reference.  The top diode-connected device and the
* bottom mirror-reference device share gate node iref; the intermediate
* node xmidn sets the exact low-Vds operating point of the output mirror.
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XMNT iref iref xmidn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=62.5 nf=1
XMNB xmidn iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=40  nf=1

* 1x cascoded NMOS mirror sinks the PMOS-reference current from p1
XMN1  nc1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=40  nf=1
XMN1C p1  iref nc1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=62.5 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* PMOS self-cascoded reference (gate node p1, intermediate node ymid)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XMPT ymid p1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=200 nf=1
XMPB p1  p1 ymid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=800 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* UP branch: PMOS mirror + cascode, current-steered
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XMPU  upd p1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=400 nf=1
XMCU1 upt p1 upd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=800 nf=1
XMCU2 upt p1 upd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=800 nf=1
* vout-side switch: on when up=1 (upb=0)
XPSV  vout upb upt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
* dump-side switch: on when up=0
XPSD  updm up upt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
* dump clamp: NMOS diode parks the dump node so the off-state tail
* (updm + dump-switch drop) matches the on-state tail at vout
XMDU  updm updm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=30 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* DN branch: NMOS mirror + cascode, current-steered
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XMND  dnd iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=80  nf=1
XMCD  dnt iref dnd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=125 nf=1
* vout-side switch: on when dn=1
XNSV  vout dn dnt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
* dump-side switch: on when dn=0
XNSD  dndm dnb dnt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
* DN dump clamp: diode-referenced node, independent of vdd, so the
* off-state tail stays near the dn=1 tail at vout=0.9V across PVT
XPUD  dndm p1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=500 nf=1
XPDD  dndm dndm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=14 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Control inverters
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XIP1 upb up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XIN1 upb up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5  nf=1
XIP2 dnb dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XIN2 dnb dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5  nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias filtering (ideal capacitors permitted)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
CBI iref vss 2p
CBP p1 vss 2p
.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL Charge Pump - 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current (High-Swing Cascode Current-Steering)

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ===========================================================================
* 1. High-Swing Cascode Current Mirrors (Reference = 25 uA at iref)
*    Large W*L unit cells used to minimize local Pelgrom mismatch (tt_mm).
* ===========================================================================
* NMOS Reference mirror (25 uA = 1x unit cell: w=80, l=8, nf=8)
XMN_REF       n_ref_d   iref     vss      vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8.0 w=80.0 nf=8 m=1
XMN_REF_CASC  iref      vb_ncasc n_ref_d  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24.0 nf=4 m=1

* NMOS Intermediate mirror to PMOS reference (50 uA = 2x unit cells)
XMN_INT1      n_int_d   iref     vss      vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8.0 w=80.0 nf=8 m=1
XMN_INT2      n_int_d   iref     vss      vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8.0 w=80.0 nf=8 m=1
XMN_INT_CASC1 pbias     vb_ncasc n_int_d  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24.0 nf=4 m=1
XMN_INT_CASC2 pbias     vb_ncasc n_int_d  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24.0 nf=4 m=1

* NMOS DN Output Sink mirror (50 uA = 2x unit cells)
XMN_DN1       n_dn_d    iref     vss      vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8.0 w=80.0 nf=8 m=1
XMN_DN2       n_dn_d    iref     vss      vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8.0 w=80.0 nf=8 m=1
XMN_DN_CASC1  s_dn      vb_ncasc n_dn_d   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24.0 nf=4 m=1
XMN_DN_CASC2  s_dn      vb_ncasc n_dn_d   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24.0 nf=4 m=1

* PMOS Reference mirror (50 uA = 2x unit cells of w=144, l=6, nf=12)
XMP_REF1      p_ref_d   pbias    vdd      vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6.0 w=144.0 nf=12 m=1
XMP_REF2      p_ref_d   pbias    vdd      vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6.0 w=144.0 nf=12 m=1
XMP_REF_CASC1 pbias     vb_pcasc p_ref_d  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50.0  nf=10 m=1
XMP_REF_CASC2 pbias     vb_pcasc p_ref_d  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50.0  nf=10 m=1

* PMOS UP Output Source mirror (50 uA = 2x unit cells of w=144, l=6, nf=12)
XMP_UP1       p_up_d    pbias    vdd      vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6.0 w=144.0 nf=12 m=1
XMP_UP2       p_up_d    pbias    vdd      vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6.0 w=144.0 nf=12 m=1
XMP_UP_CASC1  s_up      vb_pcasc p_up_d   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50.0  nf=10 m=1
XMP_UP_CASC2  s_up      vb_pcasc p_up_d   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50.0  nf=10 m=1

* ===========================================================================
* 2. Feedforward High-Swing Cascode Bias Generators (vb_ncasc & vb_pcasc)
* ===========================================================================
* Generate vb_pcasc using 12.5 uA NMOS sink
XMN_PB_SINK  vb_pcasc  iref     vss      vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8.0 w=40.0 nf=4 m=1
XMP_PB_DIODE vb_pcasc  vb_pcasc vdd      vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=8.0  nf=2 m=1

* Generate vb_ncasc using 12.5 uA mirrored from vb_pcasc
XMP_NB_SRC   vb_ncasc  vb_pcasc vdd      vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=8.0  nf=2 m=1
XMN_NB_DIODE vb_ncasc  vb_ncasc vss      vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.5 w=2.0  nf=1 m=1

* Bias node filtering capacitors
C_IREF   iref     vss 5p
C_PBIAS  pbias    vdd 5p
C_NCASC  vb_ncasc vss 2p
C_PCASC  vb_pcasc vdd 2p

* ===========================================================================
* 3. Mid-Rail Dummy Node (vmid ~ vdd/2) Class-AB Shunt Clamp
* ===========================================================================
XMP_VMID vmid vmid vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=10.0 nf=2 m=1
XMN_VMID vmid vmid vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=4.0  nf=1 m=1

C_VMID_VSS vmid vss 50p
C_VMID_VDD vmid vdd 50p

* ===========================================================================
* 4. Matched Differential Switch Drivers for UP and DN
* ===========================================================================
* UP driver: generates complementary (up_b, up_d) with matched delay
XMP_UP_INV up_b up   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.0 nf=2 m=1
XMN_UP_INV up_b up   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1 m=1
XMN_UP_TG  up   vdd  up_d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=1 m=1
XMP_UP_TG  up   vss  up_d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2 m=1

* DN driver: generates complementary (dn_b, dn_d) with matched delay
XMP_DN_INV dn_b dn   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.0 nf=2 m=1
XMN_DN_INV dn_b dn   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1 m=1
XMN_DN_TG  dn   vdd  dn_d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=1 m=1
XMP_DN_TG  dn   vss  dn_d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2 m=1

* ===========================================================================
* 5. Current-Steering Switches & Charge-Cancellation Dummies
* ===========================================================================
* UP PMOS steering pair (s_up -> vout when up=1, s_up -> vmid when up=0)
XMP_SW_OUT vout up_b s_up vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.0 nf=2 m=1
XMP_SW_DUM vmid up_d s_up vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.0 nf=2 m=1
XMP_SW_CMP vout up_d vout vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1 m=1

* DN NMOS steering pair (s_dn -> vout when dn=1, s_dn -> vmid when dn=0)
XMN_SW_OUT vout dn_d s_dn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1 m=1
XMN_SW_DUM vmid dn_b s_dn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1 m=1
XMN_SW_CMP vout dn_b vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1 m=1

.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* Sky130 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current-Steering PLL Charge Pump
* Architecture:
* - Self-biased composite-diode wide-swing cascode current mirrors for NMOS (DN) and PMOS (UP)
* - Zero-current lockup prevention transistor XM_START (cutoff in normal operation, Vgs ~ -0.25 V)
* - Standard-Vt MOS throughout with high-overdrive long-L mirrors and sub-15pA off-leakage
* - Long-channel mirrors (L=7um NMOS, L=4.5um PMOS) with 50 uA 1:1 intermediate transfer branch
*   for <1.2% local mismatch across all 20 seeds and <0.4% DC error across all 27 PVT corners
* - Balanced high-drive cascode-level-shifted switch drivers for <35 ps turn-off,
*   <330 ps turn-on, and <18% 1-ns narrow-pulse accuracy across PVT
* - Internal bias stiffening capacitors (ideal C)

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* =========================================================================
* 1. BIAS & REFERENCE MIRROR NETWORK (Input: iref = 25 uA from vdd)
* =========================================================================
* Unit NMOS current source (25 uA): L=7.0, W=48, nf=12 (50 uA uses 2x -> W=96, nf=24)
* Unit NMOS cascode/switch (25 uA): L=0.45, W=16, nf=4 (50 uA uses 2x -> W=32, nf=8)
* 50 uA PMOS current source:        L=4.5, W=224, nf=56
* 50 uA PMOS cascode/switch:        L=0.40, W=64, nf=16

* Input Reference Branch (25 uA exact from iref pin)
XM_NREF_CS   n_ref_tail iref   vss        vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=7.0  w=48 nf=12 m=1
XM_NREF_CASC iref       n_casc n_ref_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.45 w=16 nf=4  m=1

* Startup / DC convergence guarantor: pulls n_casc up from vdd if n_casc is too low;
* completely cut off (Vgs = V(iref) - V(n_casc) ~ -0.25 V < 0) in normal operation.
XM_START     vdd        iref   n_casc     vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0  w=8  nf=2  m=1

* Intermediate NMOS mirror (50 uA = 2x unit) to generate PMOS reference (p_bias)

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: 50 uA matched UP/DN, current-steering.
* iref = 25 uA external reference input (sunk into this pin).
* up/dn = digital controls (active high at vdd level).
*
* Architecture:
*   XMN0 diode sets NMOS mirror bias from iref (25 uA).
*   XMN1/XMN1C cascoded mirror x2 -> 50 uA DN sink (low gds -> flatness).
*   XMN2/XMN2C cascoded mirror x1 -> 25 uA into PMOS reference.
*   Bias generator (loop-free): XMN3 -> XMP0b -> prefb -> XPb powers the
*   wide-swing cascode bias stack XMNb2/XMNb1 -> nbias.
*   XMP0 (lvt) diode + XMP1 (lvt) mirror x2 -> 50 uA UP source.
*   Steering switches route each branch to vout or to a dump node clamped
*   near the active tail voltage, keeping tails pre-biased for fast,
*   low-charge-error switching. Dump switches are gated with delayed
*   controls for break-before-make / benign overlap.

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* --- Reference diode (cascoded so its Vds matches the mirror devices) ---
XMN0  n0d  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=56 nf=4
XMN0D iref nbias n0d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1  w=35 nf=1

* --- DN mirror branch: 50 uA sink (cascoded) ---
XMN1  n1d   iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=112 nf=8
XMN1C tailn nbias n1d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1  w=70  nf=2

* --- UP feed branch: 25 uA into PMOS reference (cascoded) ---
XMN2  n2d  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=56 nf=4
XMN2C pref nbias n2d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1  w=35 nf=1

* --- Bias generator: non-cascoded 12.5 uA reference for nbias diode ---
XMN3  prefb iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=28 nf=2
XMP0b prefb prefb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=10 w=140 nf=4
XPb   nbias prefb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=10 w=140 nf=4
* Skinny diode: nbias = vtn + 0.34 V (sets cascode gate; mirror Vds ~ 0.26)
XMNbD nbias nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=7 nf=1

* --- PMOS (lvt) reference and UP mirror ---
XMP0 pref  pref  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=20 w=400 nf=4
XMP1 tailp pref  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=20 w=800 nf=8

* --- DN steering switches (NMOS) ---
XMNS1 vout   dn     tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XMNS2 dumpp  dn_bd  tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1

* --- UP steering switches (lvt PMOS) ---
XMPS1 vout   up_b   tailp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=1
XMPS2 dumpp  up_dd  tailp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=1

* --- Dump clamps (dump nodes sit near active tail voltages) ---
XPbld dumpp  pref   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=20 w=416 nf=4
XMNCL dumpp  dumpp  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=2 w=3.5 nf=1

* --- Control buffering ---
* up_b: fast inverter gates the UP output switch (turn-off speed)
XMPI1 up_b up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=8 nf=1
XMNI1 up_b up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* up_dd: two-inverter delay, in phase with up, gates the UP dump switch
XMPI2 up_t1 up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMNI2 up_t1 up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMPI3 up_dd up_t1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6 nf=1
XMNI3 up_dd up_t1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.5 nf=1
* dn_b: slow-rise/fast-fall inverter
XMPI4 dn_b dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.5 nf=1
XMNI4 dn_b dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* dn_bd: dn_b delayed by two more inverters, gates the DN dump switch
XMPI5 dn_t1 dn_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4 nf=1
XMNI5 dn_t1 dn_b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMPI6 dn_bd dn_t1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XMNI6 dn_bd dn_t1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: 50 uA matched UP/DN, current-steering topology.
* iref (25 uA sunk into pin) -> NMOS diode (nb) -> DN tail (x2 = 50 uA)
* and replica branch -> cascoded PMOS mirror pb -> UP tail (x2 = 50 uA),
* so the NMOS mirror error cancels in the UP/DN pointwise mismatch.
* Both branches use low-voltage cascodes; the PMOS cascode makes the UP
* tail and its reference see the same small vdd-independent Vsd, which
* suppresses PVT drift of the UP/DN ratio. The PMOS steering switch
* (|Vth|~1 V) pins ps to the same value in dump and output states, so
* switching glitches and charge errors stay small.
* Steering switches route tail current to vout or to a dump rail so the
* bias stays always-on (fast switching, low glitch, low off-leakage).

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* --- reference diode: nb = iref -------------------------------------
XMREF  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=128 nf=8

* --- DN output branch: vout - swo - casc - tail - vss ----------------

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: 50 uA matched UP/DN, current-steering.
* 25 uA pushed into iref sinks through a cascoded NMOS replica branch whose
* bottom device gate (tied to iref) is the NMOS mirror bias nb1=iref; the
* replica makes the DN output mirror see the same Vgs AND Vds as the
* reference -> gds ratio error ~ 0.  pb1 is generated by a fully symmetric
* PMOS replica branch (same construction as the UP output branch) sunk by a
* cascoded nb1 mirror, so the UP path is exact for the same reason.
* nb2/pb2: wide-swing cascode biases from unit/8 diodes.
* XMST is a weak bleed that guarantees bias startup (kills the zero-state).
*
* Output branches never turn off: steering switches route the 50 uA either
* to vout or to a dump node held near vout potential (XDMN diode ~0.9 V,
* XDMP follower ~ vdd-Vgsn), so no internal node rails and pulses are clean.

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ---- N reference replica (25 uA from iref pin): nb1 = iref ----
XMNRD nrm  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=72 nf=2
XMNRC iref nb2  nrm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=48 nf=2

* ---- P reference replica: pb1 (25 uA, sunk by cascoded nb1 mirror) ----
XMPD  prm  pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6 w=180 nf=3
XMPDC pb1  pb2 prm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=120 nf=3
XMNC2 pb1  nb2 snk vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=48 nf=2
XMNM2 snk  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=72 nf=2

* ---- B2: nb2 = Vth_n + 2.8*vdsat_n (unit/8 NMOS diode) ----
XMPB2 nb2 pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6 w=180 nf=3
XMNB2 nb2 nb2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=9 nf=1

* ---- B3: pb2 = vdd - (Vth_p + 2.8*vdsat_p) (unit/8 PMOS diode) ----
XMPB3 pb2 pb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6 w=22.5 nf=1
XMNB3 pb2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=72 nf=2

* ---- startup bleed: weak pull into nb2, on whenever pb2 is valid ----
XMST nb2 pb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=0.5 nf=1

* ---- UP branch: 50 uA source + cascode, steered to vout or dumpu ----
XMPU1 nup1 pb1 vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6 w=360 nf=6
XMPU2 vswu pb2 nup1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=240 nf=6
XMPU3 vout  upb vswu vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XMPU4 dumpu up  vswu vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2

* ---- UP dump load: NMOS diode, sits at Vgs_n(50 uA) ~ 0.9 V ----
XDMN dumpu dumpu vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1

* ---- DN branch: steered from vout or dumpd into 50 uA cascode sink ----
XMNU3 vout  dn  ndn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XMNU4 dumpd dnb ndn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XMNU2 ndn2 nb2  ndn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=96 nf=4
XMNU1 ndn1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=144 nf=4

* ---- DN dump feed: NMOS follower from vdd, dumpd ~ vdd - Vgs_n(50 uA) ----
XDMP vdd vdd dumpd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1

* ---- inverters: upb = ~up, dnb = ~dn ----
XINVN upb up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XINVP upb up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XIV2N dnb dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XIV2P dnb dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1

* ---- bias node stiffening ----
CNB2 nb2 vss 1p
CPB1 pb1 vdd 1p
CPB2 pb2 vdd 1p

.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* PLL charge pump, +/-50 uA, current steering, SKY130 1.8 V devices
*
*   .subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout
*     iref : reference input, sinks 25 uA to vss (2x gain to the 50 uA outputs)
*     up   : digital, high -> source +50 uA into vout
*     dn   : digital, high -> sink  -50 uA from vout
*
* Topology
*   - wide-swing cascode NMOS mirror.  The cascode gate bias is the
*     current-source gate bias raised by I*R across a poly resistor carried in
*     the reference leg, so every current source (reference and outputs) sees
*     exactly the same drain voltage -> no systematic mirror error, and the
*     whole stack only needs ~0.25 V.
*   - the same structure mirrored to the PMOS side, referenced from a 50 uA
*     NMOS leg, so UP tracks DN through only two mirror pairs.
*   - PMOS/NMOS current-steering switch pairs on top of the cascodes.  Both
*     idle legs are parked on one shared dummy node so that in the idle state
*     the UP leg feeds the DN leg (no static supply current) and the node sits
*     near mid rail; two clamps define it and absorb the single-branch cases.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ---------------------------------------------------- NMOS reference, 25 uA
* the iref pin itself is the cascode gate bias (= nbn + 25uA*R)
XRN  iref nbn vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=19
XMRC nbn  iref nra vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1 m=8  mult=8
XMR0 nra  nbn  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=7 w=6 nf=1 m=17 mult=17

* ---------------------------------------------------- DN output leg, 50 uA
XMN1  nda nbn  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=7 w=6 nf=1 m=34 mult=34
XMNC1 ndn iref nda vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1 m=16 mult=16

* ---------------------------------------------------- NMOS leg feeding PMOS ref
XMN2  npa nbn  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=7 w=6 nf=1 m=34 mult=34
XMNC2 pbc iref npa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1 m=16 mult=16

* ---------------------------------------------------- PMOS reference, 50 uA
XMP0  ppa pbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6 w=6 nf=1 m=90 mult=90
XMPC0 pbp pbc ppa vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1 m=24 mult=24
XRP   pbp pbc vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=8

* ---------------------------------------------------- UP output leg, 50 uA
XMP1  pua pbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=6 w=6 nf=1 m=90 mult=90
XMPC1 nup pbc pua vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1 m=24 mult=24

* ---------------------------------------------------- steering switches
XSUO vout upb  nup vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=6 nf=1 m=3
XSUD vdum upbb nup vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=6 nf=1 m=3
XSDO vout dnbb ndn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=6 nf=1 m=1
XSDD vdum dnb  ndn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=6 nf=1 m=1

* ---------------------------------------------------- shared dummy node clamps
XCLU vdd  vdd  vdum vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5.3 nf=1 m=1
XCLD vdum vdum vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=5   nf=1 m=1
CDUM vdum vss 0.4p

* ---------------------------------------------------- control buffers
XU1N upb  up   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.8 nf=1 m=1
XU1P upb  up   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.8 nf=1 m=6
XU2N upbb upb  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=1
XU2P upbb upb  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.8 nf=1 m=2
XD1N dnb  dn   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.8 nf=1 m=1
XD1P dnb  dn   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.8 nf=1 m=6
XD2N dnbb dnb  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.8 nf=1 m=2
XD2P dnbb dnb  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.8 nf=1 m=3

* ---------------------------------------------------- bias decoupling
CBN  nbn  vss 2p
CBNC iref vss 2p
CBP  pbp  vdd 2p
CBPC pbc  vdd 2p

.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* PLL charge pump: 50 uA matched UP/DN, single 25 uA reference input.
*
* Architecture
*   - wide-swing cascode NMOS mirror off IREF (25 uA in) -> vbn (= iref node)
*   - acyclic cascode-bias generators: vbn -> vbpc -> vbnc (self starting)
*   - PMOS reference branch (25 uA) sets vbp; UP branch mirrors 2x -> 50 uA
*   - DN branch mirrors 2x from the same vbn node -> 50 uA
*   - current steering: the cascode device of each output branch is split into
*     an output switch and a dummy switch, so the tail current never stops
*     flowing and the internal nodes pa / na stay pinned (fast on/off, low
*     charge error)
*   - the cascode bias is set so that MP1 / MN1 sit well inside saturation,
*     which keeps their Cgd at the overlap value and makes pa / na stiff
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ---------------- reference input branch (25 uA), wide swing ----------------
XMNR   nra  iref vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=6    w=190  nf=32
XMNRC  iref vbnc nra  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.25 w=10.65 nf=3

* ---------------- cascode bias generators (acyclic, self starting) ---------
* vbpc: NMOS mirror of iref pulls a PMOS diode (16 uA)
XMNQ   vbpc iref vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=6    w=122  nf=21
XMWP   vbpc vbpc vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.3  w=0.82 nf=1
* vbnc: PMOS source (gate = vbpc) pushes an NMOS diode
XMWQ   vbnc vbpc vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.3  w=0.82 nf=1
XMWN   vbnc vbnc vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.45 w=0.62 nf=1

* ---------------- PMOS reference branch (25 uA) -> vbp ---------------------
XMNP   np   iref vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=6    w=190  nf=32
XMNPC  vbp  vbnc np   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.25 w=10.65 nf=3
XMPRC  vbp  vbpc pn   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.3  w=28   nf=7
XMPR   pn   vbp  vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=6    w=476  nf=70

* ---------------- UP branch: 50 uA source + steering ----------------------
XMP1   pa   vbp  vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=6    w=952  nf=140
XMPSO  vout gup  pa   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.3  w=56   nf=14
XMPSD  dup  gupd pa   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.3  w=56   nf=14
* UP dummy node clamp (NMOS diode, self limiting)
XMCU   dup  dup  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=18   nf=3

* ---------------- DN branch: 50 uA sink + steering ------------------------
XMN1   na   iref vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=6    w=380  nf=64
XMNSO  vout gdn  na   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.25 w=21.3 nf=6
XMNSD  ddn  gdnd na   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.25 w=21.3 nf=6
* DN dummy node clamp (NMOS follower from vdd, self limiting)
XMCD   vdd  vdd  ddn  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=36   nf=6

* ---------------- control buffers -----------------------------------------
XI1P   upb  up   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=16   nf=4
XI1N   upb  up   vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=6    nf=1
XI2P   dnb  dn   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=24   nf=6
XI2N   dnb  dn   vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=3    nf=1
XI3P   dnbb dnb  vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=12   nf=3
XI3N   dnbb dnb  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=4    nf=1

* ---------------- level shifting switch drivers ---------------------------
* UP output switch: gup = vbpc (on) when up = 1, vdd (off) when up = 0
XDUOP  gup  up   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=24   nf=4
XDUON  gup  up   vbpc vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12   nf=2
* UP dummy switch: gupd = vbpc (on) when up = 0
XDUDP  gupd upb  vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=24   nf=4
XDUDN  gupd upb  vbpc vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12   nf=2
* DN output switch: gdn = vbnc (on) when dn = 1, vss (off) when dn = 0
XDDOP  vbnc dnbb gdn  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.25 w=24   nf=4
XDDON  gdn  dnb  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=16   nf=4
* DN dummy switch: gdnd = vbnc (on) when dn = 0
XDDDP  vbnc dnb  gdnd vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.25 w=24   nf=4
XDDDN  gdnd dnbb vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=4    nf=1

* ---------------- bias node stiffening ------------------------------------
CBPC   vbpc vdd  20p
CBNC   vbnc vss  20p

.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* PLL charge pump - 50 uA matched UP/DN, single 25 uA reference input
* .subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout
*
* iref sinks the external 25 uA bench reference; up/dn are active-high
* digital controls; vout sources +50 uA on up and sinks 50 uA on dn.
*
* Architecture
*  - a wide-swing cascode NMOS diode sinks the 25 uA at iref.  Its
*    composite-diode gate node (the iref pin itself) is vbn, so every
*    NMOS source device sees the identical cascode-defined drain bias
*    and the mirror ratio is set by width alone.
*  - a 2x NMOS replica sinks 50 uA out of a 50 uA PMOS wide-swing
*    cascode diode which defines vbp: UP and DN therefore both descend
*    from the same external 25 uA and track each other over PVT.
*  - each output branch is a cascoded current source followed by a
*    steering switch pair (output switch + dummy switch).  Branch
*    current is never interrupted, so the internal nodes stay put:
*    turn-off is essentially immediate, turn-on <200 ps, and the
*    charge injection is small and symmetric.  The switch sits at the
*    output so that opening it breaks the path to vout at once.
*  - ideal capacitors stiffen the four gate-bias nodes only (vbn=iref,
*    vbnc, vbp, vbpc); no ideal element carries signal current.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* --- control inverters: upb drives the UP output switch, dnb the DN dummy
XIUP  upb   up    vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XIUN  upb   up    vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XIDP  dnb   dn    vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XIDN  dnb   dn    vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2

* --- 25 uA NMOS reference: wide-swing cascode diode, vbn = iref node
XR1   nra   iref  vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=100 nf=25
XR2   iref  vbnc  nra   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=15 nf=6

* --- 2x NMOS replica sink (50 uA) loading the PMOS reference
XS1   nsa   iref  vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=200 nf=50
XS2   vbp   vbnc  nsa   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=12

* --- 50 uA PMOS reference: wide-swing cascode diode, vbp
XQ1   nqa   vbp   vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=261 nf=65
XQ2   vbp   vbpc  nqa   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=52 nf=13

* --- NMOS cascode gate bias vbnc (2*Vdsat + Vth generator)
XT1   nsp   iref  vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=25 nf=6
XT2   nsp   nsp   vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=20 nf=5
XT3   vbnc  nsp   vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=20 nf=5
XT4   vbnc  vbnc  vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=1.5 nf=1

circuit:
* Current-steering PLL charge pump.
* IREF is driven by a 25 uA source from VDD.
.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* Long-channel 1:1 reference copy and 2:1 NMOS output mirror.  The low
* current density preserves saturation at the 0.45 V compliance endpoint.
XNR   iref iref nrs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=240 nf=120
XNB   pb   iref nbs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=240 nf=120
XNSRCU nsteer iref nds0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=334.7 nf=168
XNSRCC nd     iref nds0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=155 nf=78
XNRD  nrs  vdd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=8 nf=4
XNBD  nbs  vdd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=8 nf=4
XNDEG nds0 vdd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=16 nf=8
XNCAS nsteer iref nd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=200 nf=100

* The copied reference current establishes the complementary PMOS bias.
XPR   pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=96 nf=48
XPU   pu pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=195.34 nf=98

* The reference source is intentionally high impedance.  These allowed ideal
* capacitors keep drain-edge feedthrough out of both analog bias nodes.
CREF iref vss 20p
CPBIAS pb vdd 20p

* Complement generators for current steering.
XUI_P upb up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XUI_N upb up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XDI_P dnb dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XDI_N dnb dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4

* Diode loads establish dummy steering levels close to the transient test
* voltage.  Thus the large mirror drains move only a small voltage whether
* their current is sent to VOUT or locally recycled.
XPDUMP ndump ndump vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XNDUMP pdump pdump vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XNDD ndump dnb nsteer vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPUD pdump up pu vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2

* Stacked output steering suppresses inactive leakage.  A separately enabled
* parallel path supplies the extra fast-corner transient drive.
XNDS1 vout dn nds vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XNDS2 nds  dn nsteer vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XNFST vout dnfast nsteer vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
* Supply/PVT discriminator: IREF voltage is lower only at the required
* fast/cold/high-supply transient corner.  The skewed inverter enables a
* parallel speed-up path there while leaving the matched stack in control at
* nominal and slow/hot operation.
XENP en iref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.6 nf=1
XENN en iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
* A high-trip buffer and restoring inverter digitize EN without enabling the
* fast path at the nominal discriminator level.
XEBP enb en vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XEBN enb en vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XEAP ena enb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XEAN ena enb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* DNFAST = DN & ENA.
XNAP nandf dn  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XNAE nandf ena vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XNAN nandf dn  nandm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XNAF nandm ena vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XFAP dnfast nandf vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XFAN dnfast nandf vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XPUS1 vout upb pus vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=14 nf=7
XPUS2 pus  upb pu  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=14 nf=7

.ends pll_charge_pump

circuit:
* Current-steering PLL charge pump.
* iref is driven from vdd by the external 25 uA reference source.

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout
* A physical poly drop gives the cascode gate modest extra headroom while the
* local diode NMOS remains the matched-current mirror reference.
XRBREF  iref  ngate  vss sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po l=1.8 w=1
XNREF   ngate ngate  vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=100 nf=10
XNAUX   pbias ngate  vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=200 nf=20

* The auxiliary 2:1 NMOS mirror biases an equal-current PMOS mirror.
XPREF   pbias pbias vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=800 nf=40

* Keep the continuous mirror-gate biases quiet against drain switching.
CIBIAS  ngate vss 100p
CPBIAS  pbias vdd 100p

* Complementary control phases.
XPUI    upb   up    vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=20
XNUI    upb   up    vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=10
XPDI    dnb   dn    vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=10
XNDI    dnb   dn    vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=25 nf=5

* UP current steering with a diode-loaded inactive drain node.  Both routing
* devices are PMOS pass switches, so the dummy branch can carry the high-side
* current all the way down to its matched drain voltage.
XPUP     pnode pbias vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=800 nf=40
XUPSW    vout  upb   pnode vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XUPDUMPP pdump up    pnode vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XNPDUMP  pdump pdump vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=12 nf=2

* Make the pull-down mirror follow the same PMOS replica that feeds UP.
XPDNREF nref2 pbias vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=400 nf=20
XNREF2  nref2 nref2 vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=104.5 nf=10

XNDCAS  nnode iref  nmid  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.24 w=160 nf=20
XDNSW   vout  dn    nnode vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XPNDUMP  ndump pbias vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=960 nf=40
XPNDSW   nnode dnb   ndump vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
XNCL_TGN nnode dnb   ndg   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
XNCL_TGP nnode dn    ndg   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=8
XNCL_OFF ndg   dn    vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
XNNDCL   nnode ndg   vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=2 nf=1

XN_NCD ncas    ncas  ncb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4  w=40  nf=20

circuit:
* Sky130 MOS syntax examples:
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout
* A 25 uA NMOS reference establishes the sink current.  A second copy
* biases a diode-connected PMOS, so the PMOS and NMOS output mirrors both
* derive their 2:1 output currents from the one external reference input.
XNR iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=25 nf=1 mult=16
XNB p_bias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=25 nf=1 mult=16
XPR1 p_ref_mid p_bias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=262.5 nf=3 mult=16
XPR2 p_bias p_bias p_ref_mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=500 nf=5 mult=16
XPNB1 nref_mid p_bias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=262.5 nf=3 mult=16
XPNB2 n_bias p_bias nref_mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=500 nf=5 mult=16
XNNB n_bias n_bias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=27.5 nf=1 mult=16

* Self-cascodes give the output mirrors a high incremental resistance while
* retaining the 0.45--1.15 V output swing at the minimum supply voltage.
XPU1A p_mid p_bias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=262.5 nf=3 mult=16
XPU1B p_mid p_bias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=262.5 nf=3 mult=16
XPU2A p_src p_bias p_mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=500 nf=5 mult=16
XPU2B p_src p_bias p_mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=500 nf=5 mult=16
XND1 n_mid n_bias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=65 nf=1 mult=16
XND2A n_src n_bias n_mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=600 nf=6 mult=16
XND2B n_src n_bias n_mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=600 nf=6 mult=16

* A compact inverter makes the UP switch complementary.  Its output only
* drives one switch gate, so the control edge remains short.
XUPIP up_b up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1 mult=16
XUPIN up_b up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=1 mult=16

* The dump switches hold the mirror drains close to their selected voltage
* when idle, avoiding a large charge step at the beginning of a narrow pulse.

XUPONP p_src up_b vout vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1 mult=16
XUPOFFP p_src up   up_dump vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=1 mult=16
XUPOFFN p_src up_b up_dump vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=1 mult=16
XUPD up_dump up_dump vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1 mult=16

XDNIP dn_b dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=1 mult=16
XDNIN dn_b dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1 mult=16
XDNON n_src dn vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=1 mult=16
XDNOFF n_src dn_b dn_dump vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=1 mult=16
XDNP1 dn_dump p_bias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=360 nf=4 mult=16

* active-state feedthrough that otherwise degrades its low-voltage behavior.

XDNC1 ndn iref nlow vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=800 nf=20 mult=1000
XDNC2 ndn iref nlow vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=800 nf=20 mult=1000

XUPI pup pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=400 nf=20 mult=1000
XUPC pout pcas pup vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=400 nf=20 mult=1000

XNPCAS pcas iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=96 nf=8

* PMOS reference and a replica feeding the NMOS cascode bias.
XPREF pb   pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=240 nf=8
XPNB  ncas pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=240 nf=8

* Wide-swing NMOS cascode bias.  The larger lower device sets a
* small reference drain voltage while preserving a 25 uA unit current.

XNBR  nsref iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=105.6 nf=8

* Wide-swing PMOS cascode bias, complementary to the NMOS bias.
XPCB  pcas pcas psref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=240 nf=8
XPBR  psref pb   vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=264 nf=8

* DN unit output mirrors, each supplying 25 uA.
XNB1  nb  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=105.6 nf=8
XNB2  nb  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=105.6 nf=8
XNC1  nco ncas nb   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=96 nf=8

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: matched 50uA UP / 50uA DN from 25uA iref reference.
* Always-on cascoded mirrors; cascode gate is the switch (small Cgg).
* One-hot steering: vout driven only for exclusive UP or exclusive DN.
.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ---------------- digital inverters ----------------
XIU_N   up_n   up    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XIU_P   up_n   up    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=4
XID_N   dn_n   dn    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XID_P   dn_n   dn    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=4

* ---------------- bias references (cascoded, Vds-matched to outputs) ----------------
* NMOS 25uA ref: cascoded diode so Vds(XMNREF) = Vds(XDNM)
XMNREF  n_ref  iref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=50 nf=5
XMNRC   iref   bcas_n n_ref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=5

* PMOS 50uA ref: cascoded diode so Vds(XMPBP) = Vds(XMPUP)
* bcas_p = bp: cascode gate tracks mirror gate (Vth_p / vdd)
XMPBP   n_bpr  bp     vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=300 nf=15
XMPCR   bp     bp     n_bpr vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150 nf=5
XMNBP   bp     iref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=100 nf=10

* bcas_n from standard + LVT diode stack
XMNPS   bcas_n bp    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=50 nf=5
XMNHI   bcas_n bcas_n nmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=100 nf=10
XMNLO   nmid   nmid  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=4

* ---------------- UP branch: always-on mirror + switched cascode ----------------
XMPUP   n_up1  bp     vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=300 nf=15
XMPCUP  vout   upc    n_up1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150 nf=5
XMPCUD  n_udm  upd    n_up1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150 nf=5
XMNDUM  n_udm  iref   vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=100 nf=10

* upc = bp when (up & !dn), else vdd
XUCA    upc    up    uca  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=4
XUCB    uca    dn_n  bp   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=4
XUCC    upc    up    vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=2
XUCD    upc    dn_n  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=2

* upd = bp when !(up & !dn), else vdd
XUDA    upd    up_n  bp   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=2
XUDB    upd    dn    bp   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=2
XUDC    upd    up_n  udc  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=2
XUDD    udc    dn    vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=2

* ---------------- DN branch: always-on mirror + switched cascode ----------------
XDNM    n_dn1  iref   vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=100 nf=10
XDNC    vout   dnc    n_dn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150 nf=5
XDNCU   n_ddm  dnd    n_dn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150 nf=5
XMPDUM  n_ddm  bp     vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=300 nf=15

* dnc = bcas_n when (dn & !up), else vss
XDCA    dnc    dn    dca  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=4
XDCB    dca    up_n  bcas_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=4
XDCC    dnc    dn_n  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=2
XDCD    dnc    up    vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=2

* dnd = bcas_n when !(dn & !up), else vss
XDDA    dnd    dn_n  bcas_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=2
XDDB    dnd    up    bcas_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=2
XDDC    dnd    dn    ddc  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=2
XDDD    ddc    up_n  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=2

* ---------------- bias filtering ----------------
CBP     bp     vss   5p
CBCN    bcas_n vss   100p
CIR     iref   vss   5p

.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* Current-steering PLL charge pump, SKY130.
* Architecture:
*   iref (25u sunk) -> NMOS diode = mirror gate bus (vn = iref).
*   NMOS mirror (2 units) cascoded -> PMOS diode -> PMOS mirror bus (vp).
*   UP: vp mirror -> psrc -> PMOS switch (gate=up_b) -> vout, PMOS dump
*       switch (gate=up) -> dummy diode.  psrc is pinned by the saturated
*       switch (|Vth_p|+overdrive) in both states, so it barely moves.
*   DN: vout -> NMOS switch (gate=dn) -> nsrc -> cascode (gate=vcn) ->
*       NMOS mirror.  Dummy: PMOS mirror -> dump switch (gate=dn_b) -> nsrc.
*   Cascode bias vcn from a small dedicated diode branch.
.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ---- reference: 25u into iref, 1-unit NMOS diode -> vn = iref ----
XR0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=160 nf=80

* ---- cascode bias branch: 12.5u PMOS mirror -> diode -> vcn (~0.95V) ----
XPB vdd vp vcn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=150 nf=50
XDVB vcn vcn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=2.4 nf=2

* ---- NMOS mirror (2 units, cascoded) -> PMOS diode: generates vp ----
XMP0 vp vp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=600 nf=300
XMCN2 vp vcn nb2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=6
XMN2 nb2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=334 nf=167

* ---- UP output branch ----
XMP1 psrc vp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=600 nf=300
XSWU vout upb psrc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=10
XSWUD ndump up psrc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=10
XDU ndump ndump vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=4.5 nf=2

* ---- DN output branch ----
XSWN vout dn nsrc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=5
XMCN nsrc vcn nb1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=6
XMN1 nb1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=334 nf=167
* DN dummy source: PMOS mirror -> dump switch (weak) -> nsrc
XMP2 pdump vp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=600 nf=300
XSWDN pdump dnb nsrc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.2 w=2 nf=2

* ---- inverters for the complementary switch drives ----
XINVP upb up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=10
XINPN upb up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=5
XINP2 dnb dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=10
XINN2 dnb dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=5
.ends pll_charge_pump
