taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: current steering, cascoded 50uA UP/DN branches.
* iref (25uA) -> NMOS diode N0 -> VGN.  Cascoded N1 replica branch feeds the
* PMOS mirror (P0/P0C, Vsd matched to the UP output stack) -> VGP.  Both UP
* and DN current sources therefore see identical Vds/Vsd and identical
* per-finger geometry.  Wide-swing cascode biases VCASN/VCASP from Sooch
* diodes.  Steering switches keep both current sources conducting (dump
* loads hold the steering nodes near vout).

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ---------------- reference: iref -> N0 diode -> VGN --------------
XN0   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=70 nf=4

* ---------------- cascoded N1 replica branch ----------------------
XN1   n_y1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=71.75 nf=4
XN1C  n_vgp n_vcasn n_y1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=23.5 nf=2

* ---------------- PMOS reference branch (Vsd-matched replica) -----
XP0   vdd n_vgp n_xr vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=10 w=269 nf=4
XP0C  n_xr n_vcasp n_vgp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=107.5 nf=2

* ---------------- cascode bias generators ------------------------
XNVC  n_vcasp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=35 nf=4
XPVC  vdd n_vcasp n_vcasp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=3.5 nf=1
XPIV  vdd n_vgp n_vcasn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=10 w=269 nf=4
XNVI  n_vcasn n_vcasn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.9 nf=1

* ---------------- DN branch: sinks 50uA from vout ----------------
XNCS  n_y iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=143.5 nf=8
XNCAS n_s n_vcasn n_y vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=47 nf=4
XNOUT vout dn n_s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XNDMP n_dnn n_dnb n_s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4

* DN dump load: PMOS source (62.5u) + NMOS clamp diode (n_dnn ~ 0.9)
XPDL  vdd n_vgp n_dnn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=10 w=672 nf=10
XNDL  n_dnn n_dnn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.3 nf=1

* ---------------- UP branch: sources 50uA into vout --------------
XPCS  vdd n_vgp n_x vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=10 w=538 nf=8
XPCAS n_t n_vcasp n_x vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=215 nf=4
XPOUT vout n_upb n_t vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=4
XPDMP n_dnp up n_t vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=4

* UP dump load: NMOS clamp diode (n_dnp ~ 0.9)
XUDL  n_dnp n_dnp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5.2 nf=1

* ---------------- gate-drive inverters ---------------------------
XIU_N n_upb up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XIU_P n_upb up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XID_N n_dnb dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XID_P n_dnb dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump, SKY130, current-steering cascoded topology.
* UP branch: PMOS current source -> PMOS differential pair steers 50uA
*   between vout and an NMOS-diode dummy sink.
* DN branch: NMOS differential pair steers 50uA from vout/dummy into an
*   NMOS cascode and a 2:1 NMOS mirror sink.
* Both mirror stages share the same 2:1 NMOS mirror so their systematic
* VDS-induced errors cancel in UP-DN.

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ---------------- reference ----------------
* IREF (25uA external) into an NMOS diode sets iref as the mirror gate bias.
* XB_REF also matches XMN_A/XMN1's drain-source bias so the 2:1 ratio is
* accurate; CREF stiffens the node against UP/DN switching kickback.
XB_REF  iref  iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=8 w=128 nf=32

* ---------------- 2:1 NMOS mirror (cascoded) -> PMOS diode ----------------
* XMN_A drain sits at the same potential as the DN sink drain (via XMC_A),
* so its systematic error matches XMN1's and cancels in UP-DN.
XMN_A   ma   iref vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=8 w=263 nf=64
XMC_A   vbp  vcas_n  ma  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=1 w=64 nf=16
XP_B    vbp  vbp  vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=2 w=128 nf=32

* ---------------- NMOS cascode bias branch (25uA) ----------------
* XN_CD is half the width of the output cascodes at the same W/L, so its
* current density matches and nx reproduces the cascode source voltage.
XP_BN   vcas_n  vbp  vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=4 w=128 nf=32
XN_CD   vcas_n  vcas_n  nx  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=1 w=32 nf=8
XN_TR   nx  vcas_n  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=6 w=8 nf=2

* ---------------- UP branch ----------------
* vdd -> XP_UP -> xp -> steering pair -> vout | dum_p -> XDUM_P -> vss
XP_UP   xp  vbp  vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=2 w=128 nf=32
XUP_V   vout  up_b  xp  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=24 nf=12
XUP_D   dum_p  up  xp  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=24 nf=12
XDUM_P  dum_p  dum_p  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=1 w=16 nf=4

* ---------------- DN branch ----------------
* vout | dum_n -> steering pair -> sn -> cascode -> zn -> XMN1 -> vss
XDN_V   vout  dn  sn  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt  l=0.5 w=16 nf=8
XDN_D   dum_n  dn_b  sn  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt  l=0.5 w=16 nf=8
XMC_N   sn  vcas_n  zn  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=1 w=64 nf=16
XMN1    zn  iref vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=8 w=261 nf=64
XDUM_N  dum_n  dum_n  vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=512 nf=32

* ---------------- control inverters ----------------
XIP1  up_b  up  vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=96 nf=32
XIN1  up_b  up  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=32 nf=16
XIP2  dn_b  dn  vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=96 nf=32
XIN2  dn_b  dn  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=32 nf=16

* ---------------- bias filtering ----------------
CREF  iref vss  4p
CPM   vbp  vss  4p
CCN   vcas_n  vss  2p

.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump, current-steering, SKY130
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Local inverter used for the switch drivers.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt cp_inv in out vdd vss
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
.ends cp_inv

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ------------------------------ bias chain --------------------------------
* External 25 uA into iref; N0 is diode connected -> Vb_n = iref.
* N1 (2 units) feeds the PMOS diode P0 -> Vb_p = pb.
* N2 (2 units) is the always-on DN current source (sinks from yn).
* P1 (2 units) is the always-on UP current source (sources into yp).
XN0  iref iref vss vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=88  nf=8
XN1  pb   iref  vss vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=176 nf=16
XN2  yn   iref  vss vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=176 nf=16
XP0  pb   pb    vdd vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=280 nf=16
XP1  yp   pb    vdd vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=280 nf=16

* --------------------------- cascode bias voltages ------------------------
* Vc_n = Vgs of a small diode NFET sized so that yn lands just above the
* saturation overdrive of the DN current source.
XPBN vcn pb   vdd vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=28  nf=1
XNCN vcn vcn  vss vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=2.3 nf=1
* Vc_p = vdd - Vgs of a small diode PFET sized so that ap tracks vdd minus
* a fixed offset.
XNCP vcp iref vss vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=17.6 nf=1
XPCP vcp vcp  vdd vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=12.7 nf=1

* ------------------------------ DN branch ---------------------------------
* vout -> Nc_out -> an -> Na -> yn -> N2 -> vss
XNCOUT vout vcn  an  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XNA    an   gdn  yn  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* Dummy: vdd -> Pd_n -> hdn -> Nc_dum -> bn -> Nb -> yn
XPDN   hdn  pb   vdd vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=35  nf=1
XNCDUM hdn  vcn  bn  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XNB    bn   gdnb yn  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ------------------------------ UP branch ---------------------------------
* vdd -> P1 -> yp -> Pa -> ap -> Pc_out -> vout
XPCOUT vout vcp  ap vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=9  nf=1
XPA    ap   gup  yp vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8  nf=1
* Dummy: yp -> Pb -> bp -> Pc_dum -> ldp -> Nd_p -> vss
XPB    bp   gupb yp vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8  nf=1
XPCDUM ldp  vcp  bp vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=9  nf=1
XNDP   ldp  iref vss vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=22  nf=1

* ------------------------------ switch drivers ----------------------------
XINV1 up   gup  vdd vss cp_inv
XINV2 gup  gupb vdd vss cp_inv
XINV3 dn   gdnb vdd vss cp_inv
XINV4 gdnb gdn  vdd vss cp_inv

* --------------------------- bias node stiffening -------------------------
Cb_n iref vss 2p
Cb_p pb   vss 2p
Cc_n vcn  vss 1p
Cc_p vcp  vss 1p

.ends pll_charge_pump

* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout
* MOS-only current-steering charge pump.
* The external bench provides 25 uA into iref; local mirrors scale it to 50 uA.

* Reference diode and PMOS bias generator.
XMN_REF    iref   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=80  nf=40
XMN_PBIAS  vbp    iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=80  nf=40

XMP_NCAS_I vcn    vbp  vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=220 nf=110
XMN_NCAS_C vcn    vcn  ncasx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=160 nf=80

XMN_DN_B   ndn_m  vbnd vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=233 nf=95
XMN_DN_C1  ndn_i  vcn  ndn_m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=466 nf=190
XMN_UD_B   nupd_m vbnd vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=233 nf=95
XMN_UD_C1  updump vcn  nupd_m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=466 nf=190

XMP_UP_C1  nup_i  vcp  nup_m vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=880 nf=440
XMP_DD_L1  dndump dndump vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=600 nf=300
XMP_DD_L2  dndump dndump vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=600 nf=300
XMP_DD_L3  dndump dndump vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=470 nf=235

* CMOS gate inverters for switch drive.
XMP_UPI  upb    up     vdd    vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=40
XMN_UPI  upb    up     vss    vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=20
XMP_DNBI dnbf   dn     vdd    vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=10
XMN_DNBI dnbf   dn     vss    vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=10
XMP_UPN1 upg    up     vdd    vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=10
XMP_UPN2 upg    dnbf   vdd    vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=10
XMN_UPN1 upg    up     upn_s  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=40
XMN_UPN2 upn_s  dnbf   vss    vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=40
XMP_DNN1 dnn    dn     vdd    vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=10
XMP_DNN2 dnn    upb    vdd    vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=10
XMN_DNN1 dnn    dn     dnn_s  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2  nf=1
XMN_DNN2 dnn_s  upb    vss    vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2  nf=1
XMP_DND  dndrv  dnn    vdd    vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=3
XMN_DND  dndrv  dnn    vss    vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=10

* Stacked output switches suppress inactive leakage.
XMP_US1  nup_s  upg    nup_i  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=5
XMP_US2  vout   upg    nup_s  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=5

XMN_DS1  vout   dndrv  ndn_s  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=25 nf=10
XMN_DS2  ndn_s  dndrv  ndn_i  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=25 nf=10

CDNB vbnd vss 1p
.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: 50 uA matched UP/DN current steering, SKY130 1.8 V core.
* External interface: vss iref up dn vdd vout.  iref is the only analog bias
* input (the bench injects 25 uA into it); up/dn are rail-to-rail controls.
*
* Architecture
*   Every mirror is an integer multiple of one unit cell, so the mirror ratios
*   are purely geometric and track the reference current across PVT.
*   DN branch : 2x NMOS mirror -> NMOS cascode (gate vbn) -> NMOS switch.
*   UP bias   : 2x NMOS mirror -> NMOS cascode (gate vbn) -> PMOS diode at bp.
*   UP branch : 1:1 PMOS (lvt) mirror -> PMOS cascode (gate vbp2) -> PMOS switch.
*   Cascoding both NMOS mirrors with the same gate bias forces the reference
*   current pulled out of the PMOS diode to equal the DN branch current, and the
*   fixed cascode bias points hold each mirror device at a nearly constant Vds
*   over the whole 0.45-1.15 V output compliance range (flatness).

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ---- reference cell: diode-connected NMOS sinking the external 25 uA ----
XREF  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=12

* ---- DN branch: 2x NMOS mirror, cascode, drain-side switch ----
XMIRDN ndn  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=12.29 m=2
XCASDN nswd vbn  ndn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=12 m=2
XSWDN  vout dn   nswd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8

* ---- UP bias chain: 2x NMOS mirror + cascode pulls 50 uA through the diode ----
XMIRB  nb0 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=12.53 m=2
XCASB  bp  vbn  nb0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=12 m=2
XDIOP  bp  bp   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=27 m=2

* ---- UP branch: 1:1 PMOS mirror, cascode, drain-side switch ----
XMIRUP nxup bp   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=27 m=2
XCASUP nswp vbp2 nxup vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=27 m=2
XSWUP  vout up_n nswp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8

* ---- cascode gate bias vbn: PMOS pulls half the UP-chain current into a W/L=1
* ---- NMOS diode, so vbn tracks the branch current across PVT ----
XPSRC  vbn bp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=27
XBDN   vbn vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2

* ---- cascode gate bias vbp2: PMOS diode fed by a 1x mirror of iref ----
XNSRC  vbp2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=6
XBUP   vbp2 vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=1.5

* ---- control inverter (up_n) ----
XINV_P up_n up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12
XINV_N up_n up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6


.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: 25uA reference in, +-50uA current-steering UP/DN outputs.
*
* Architecture
*   N1 is a 25uA NMOS reference diode (W/L = 11.25).  N2 (2x) is the DN sink and
*   N3 (2x) feeds the PMOS bias diode P1, from which P2 mirrors the UP source.
*   Both current sources are cascoded (N2C / P2C) so the output current does not
*   depend on the output-node voltage: that is what sets the DC flatness.  The
*   cascode bulks are tied to their own sources, so their threshold matches the
*   zero-Vsb threshold of the bias generator.  XN5/XP5 and XP7/XN6 generate the
*   two cascode gate biases at 1/8 current and 4x current density, i.e. exactly
*   Vth+2*Vov, which is what a cascode needs to sit one Vov above the mirror.
*   Each output is steered by an LVT CMOS transmission gate.  While a branch is
*   off, an LVT dump switch holds its cascode drain at the same voltage it has
*   when the branch is on (du / dd are diodes at the same current density as the
*   on-state switch drop), so switching moves almost no charge at vout.
.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ---- reference: 25uA NMOS diode (W/L = 11.25) ----
XN1 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=45 nf=1

* ---- DN sink: 2x mirror (50uA, W/L = 22.5) plus cascode ----
XN2 wdn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=90 nf=2
XN2C y ncas wdn wdn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=90 nf=2

* ---- N3: 2x mirror that feeds the PMOS bias diode ----
XN3 pdn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=90 nf=2

* ---- PMOS bias diode (50uA, W/L = 50), 1x UP source and cascode ----
XP1 pdn pdn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=200 nf=4
XP2 wup pdn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=200 nf=4
XP2C x ncp wup wup sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=200 nf=4

* ---- cascode gate biases: 1/8 current, 4x current density ----
XP5 ncas pdn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=25 nf=1
XN5 ncas ncas vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=2.8 nf=1
XN6 ncp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=11.25 nf=1
XP7 ncp ncp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=6.3 nf=1

* ---- UP output switch: LVT transmission gate ----
XSUN vout up x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=40 nf=1
XSUP vout upb x vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=52 nf=1

* ---- UP dump: holds x at the on-state level while UP is off ----
XDU x upb du vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=40 nf=1
XDU2 du du vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=14 nf=1

* ---- DN output switch: LVT transmission gate ----
XSDD vout dn y vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=40 nf=1
XSDN vout dnb y vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=52 nf=1

* ---- DN dump: P4 (1.1x) sources into y through the dump switch ----
XP4 dd pdn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=220 nf=4
XDD2 dd dd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=1.35 nf=1
XDP dd dnb y vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=40 nf=1

* ---- control inverters ----
XIP upb up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=1
XIN upb up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15 nf=1
XDP2 dnb dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=1
XDN2 dnb dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15 nf=1

.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump -- current-steering output stage with always-on tails.
* UP sources 50uA into vout, DN sinks 50uA from vout.  25uA reference at iref.
* Both output devices are Vds-matched replicas of a reference device that
* carries the same current density at the same drain voltage, so the 2x mirror
* ratio is geometric and independent of vout, temperature and headroom.

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ================= NMOS reference (Vds-matched) =================
* iref (25uA) flows into iref.  MC1 is the cascode; MN1 has its gate on the top
* node iref so its Vgs is not tied to its own Vds: Vds(MN1) = Vbc_n-Vgs(MC1),
* which is exactly the drain voltage nF of the 2x mirror devices.
XMC1 iref nbn nS vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=60 nf=4
XMN1 nS iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=60 nf=4
CIR iref vss 2p
CVBN iref vss 2p

* ================= cascode bias Vbc_n = Vbn + Vov_b =================
XMPB1 nbn nT vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=8.3 nf=1
XMNB1 nbn nbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1.32 nf=1
XSTART nbn vss vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=0.42 nf=1
CVBCN nbn vss 1p

* ================= cascode bias Vbc_p =================
XMNB2 nbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=6 nf=1
XMPB2 nbp nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=1.04 nf=1
CVBCP nbp vss 1p

* ================= PMOS reference (Vds-matched) + sink =================
* vdd -> MP1 -> nU -> MPC1 -> nT -> MN2C -> nS2 -> MN2 -> vss
* Vbp = nT; Vds(MP1) = vdd-nU = Vds(MP_up) because both cascodes see the same
* gate bias and current density.
XMP1 nU nT vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=83 nf=4
XMPC1 nT nbp nU vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=93 nf=4
XMN2C nT nbn nS2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=120 nf=8
XMN2 nS2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=120 nf=8
CBP nT vss 2p

* ================= UP branch (source 50uA into vout) =================
* nB is the steering node, held near the on-state voltage by the dump diode
* whether the branch is on or off, so switching moves almost no charge.
* XMS1 (NMOS, gate=up) carries vout up to ~1.0V; above that its source
* follower action dies, so XMSP (PMOS, gate=upb) takes over.  At vout=0.9V
* nB is only ~1.0V, below |Vth| of XMSP, so only XMS1 conducts there and the
* turn-off stays as fast as the bare NMOS switch.
XMPU nA nT vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=83 nf=4
XMPC nB nbp nA vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=93 nf=4
XMS1 nB up vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15 nf=1
XMSP nB upb vout vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=1
* dump path: the switch sits at the bottom so its gate threshold is one
* Vth above vss (0.6V) instead of one Vth above the diode node (1.6V).
* upb therefore opens it early in its rise, before the output switch closes,
* so the tail current is never stranded on nB (that charge was being lost).
XMND nB nB nM vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XMS2 nM upb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15 nf=1

* ================= DN branch (sink 50uA from vout) =================
XMS3 vout dn nC vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15 nf=1
XMS4 nE dnb nC vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15 nf=1
XMCC nC nbn nF vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=120 nf=8
XMNDN nF iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=120 nf=8
XMPD vdd vdd nE vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=35 nf=1

* ================= control inverters =================
XMPI1 upb up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMNI1 upb up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMPI2 dnb dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMNI2 dnb dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: current-steering, self-cascode cascoded 2x mirrors.
* iref (25uA) is the only analog bias; up/dn are digital controls.
* UP branch sources 2*iref into vout, DN branch sinks 2*iref from vout.
*
* Node iref is the NMOS mirror gate and also the top of the reference stack, so
* the reference branch is a self-starting diode stack carrying exactly iref.
* The reference cascode and the output cascode share gate iref and are sized 1:2
* at 1:2 current, so their source nodes (B1 and B2n) settle at the same
* voltage: the output device drain is forced equal to the reference drain.
* The PMOS side is the mirror image, its reference current forced by the
* 1:1 NMOS feed mirror MN3/MN3c.

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

*--- NMOS reference stack: the iref pin is the mirror gate node ---
XMN1   B1   iref    vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=20 w=26  nf=1
XMN1c  iref    iref    B1   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=2  w=59  nf=1

*--- NMOS feed mirror: sinks the PMOS reference current ---
XMN3   B3   iref    vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=20 w=26  nf=1
XMN3c  Gp   iref    B3   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=2  w=59  nf=1

*--- PMOS reference stack ---
XMP1   B1p  Gp   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=20 w=70  nf=2
XMP1c  Gp   Gp   B1p  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=2  w=115 nf=2

*--- DN branch: sinks 2*iref from vout ---
XMN2   B2n  iref    vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=20 w=52  nf=2
XMN2c  S2n  iref    B2n  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=2  w=118 nf=2
XSWnN  S2n  dn   vout vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSWnP  S2n  dnb  vout vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=7 nf=1

*--- UP branch: sources 2*iref into vout ---
XMP2   B2p  Gp   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=20 w=140 nf=4
XMP2c  S2p  Gp   B2p  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=2  w=230 nf=4
XSWpN  S2p  up   vout vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSWpP  S2p  upb  vout vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=7 nf=1

*--- control buffers ---
XINV1N upb  up   vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XINV1P upb  up   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XINV2N dnb  dn   vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XINV2P dnb  dn   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=5 nf=1

.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: current-steering, cascode current sources, 25uA ref -> 50uA UP/DN.
* Interface: pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout
* UP sources +50uA into vout when up=1 (otherwise dumps to vss).
* DN sinks -50uA from vout when dn=1 (otherwise dumps from vdd).

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Reference bottom biases (25uA)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* NMOS reference diode: iref (carries the external 25uA).
XMN0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=40 nf=8
* PMOS reference diode: pbias, fed by a mirror of iref.
XMPR pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=120 nf=20
XMN1 pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=40 nf=8

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* PMOS cascode bias Vpc (works well; single NMOS sink).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMPBR vpc_src pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=120 nf=20
XMPCD vpc vpc vpc_src vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMN2 vpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=40 nf=8

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* NMOS cascode bias Vnc: vss-referenced level shifter so the DN bottom
* drain (dn_int) sits at ~Vov regardless of vdd, preserving DN headroom.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMN_SF   nvb iref vdd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=200 nf=32
XMN_SINK nvb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=80 nf=16
XMN_CD   vnc vnc nvb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7 nf=2
XMP_VNC  vnc pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=120 nf=20

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Digital complements
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMPI upb up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=2
XMNI upb up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMPJ dnb dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=2
XMNJ dnb dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* UP branch: PMOS cascode current source (50uA), steer to vout or dump to vss
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMPB up_int pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=240 nf=40
XMPC up_out vpc up_int vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
* Transmission-gate switch between up_out and vout.
XMSUP up_out up vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMSPUP up_out upb vout vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
* Dump switch (PMOS) from up_out to vss, on when up=0.
XMPD vss up up_out vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* DN branch: NMOS cascode current source (50uA), steer from vout or dump from vdd
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMNB dn_int iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=144 nf=24
XMNC dn_out vnc dn_int vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=14 nf=4
* Transmission-gate switch between vout and dn_out.
XMSDN vout dn dn_out vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMSPDN vout dnb dn_out vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
* Dump switch (NMOS) from vdd to dn_out, on when dn=0.
XMND vdd dnb dn_out vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: current-steering UP/DN with one external reference current.
* iref = 25 uA sink (external).  up/dn digital controls; vout output node.
* UP sources +50 uA into vout when up=1; DN sinks 50 uA when dn=1.
*
* Bias:
*   M1      : NMOS diode at iref, 25 uA (external reference).
*   MPD/MND : up-leg stack. MPD is a PMOS diode from vdd to pgb; MND is an
*             NMOS mirror of M1 (gate tied to iref) so the up-leg current is
*             forced to the 25 uA reference. pgb self-biases to the PMOS Vgs
*             needed to pass that same 25 uA, giving the PMOS mirror gate.
* DN branch (sink 50 uA):
*   MSINK   : 2x M1 mirror, always on, drains from either vout or the DN dummy.
*   SWDN    : NMOS output switch vout <-> nsink, gate = dn.
*   SWDND   : NMOS dummy switch dndum <-> nsink, gate = dnb.
*   DMDP    : PMOS diode clamp on dndum (~vdd - |Vgs|) supplies the dummy path.
* UP branch (source 50 uA):
*   MPSRC   : 2x MPD mirror, always on, sources to either vout or the UP dummy.
*   SWUP    : PMOS output switch nup <-> vout, gate = upb.
*   SWUPD   : PMOS dummy switch nup <-> nupdum, gate = up.
*   DMUP    : NMOS diode clamp on nupdum (~Vgs) sinks the dummy path.
* Inverters generate upb and dnb from the digital controls.

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* --- Reference NMOS diode (25 uA) ---
XM1  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=24 nf=6

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: 50 uA matched UP/DN current-steering charge pump.
* Single external reference current input iref (25 uA nominal).
* up/dn are digital controls (active high).
* Current-steering topology: both wide-swing cascoded mirrors are always on;
* each output is steered between vout and a dump rail by a complementary
* switch pair, so the mirror internal nodes never collapse and the switching
* glitch is dominated only by the small cascade-drain capacitance.
* Long-channel mirrors (L=8 NMOS / L=4 PMOS) reduce local mismatch, which is
* what bounds the pointwise UP/DN matching spec.

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* --- NMOS bias: nb = iref diode, nc from wide-swing cascode stack ---
XMN0  iref  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=105.6 nf=16
XMN1  pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=105.6 nf=16
XMP0  pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=103.2 nf=16
XMP1  ncas pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=103.2 nf=16
XNc   ncas ncas nvb  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=187.2 nf=28
XNb   nvb  iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=144 nf=32

* --- PMOS bias: pc from wide-swing cascode stack --------------------
XMN2  pcas iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=105.6 nf=16
XMPb  pvb  pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=206.4 nf=32
XPc   pcas pcas pvb  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=80.6 nf=12

* --- DN (pull-down): always-on NMOS cascode mirror + steer switches ---
XDNb  dn_mid iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=288 nf=64
XDNc  dn_out ncas dn_mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=374.4 nf=56
XDNsv vout  dn   dn_out vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XDNsd vdd   dnb  dn_out vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* --- UP (pull-up): always-on PMOS cascode mirror + steer switches ----
XUPb  up_mid pbias vdd    vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=412.8 nf=64
XUPc  up_out pcas up_mid  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=161.2 nf=24
XUPsv vout   upb  up_out  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XUPsd vss    up   up_out  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2

* --- Inverters: upb = NOT up, dnb = NOT dn ---------------------------
XMPinv  upb up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMNinv  upb up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMPinv2 dnb dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMNinv2 dnb dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: current steering with one external 25 uA reference.
* Reference diode NMOS XNR sinks the 25 uA injected at iref and develops
* nbias. A matched copy XNP forces 25 uA through diode PMOS XPP, developing
* pbias. 2x output devices XPU/XND give 50 uA; differential lvt switch
* pairs steer each always-on current source to vout or to a dummy
* terminator, so the sources never switch on/off.

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* --- local geometry parameters (um; library scale=1u) ---
.param lmir=4
.param wnr=12
.param wpp=6
.param wpu=12
.param wnd=24
.param wswp=10
.param wswn=6
.param wdtp=6
.param wdtn=22

* inverted digital controls
XINVP up  up_b vdd vss inv_cp
XINVD dn  dn_b vdd vss inv_cp

* --- 25 uA NMOS reference (diode), nbias = iref pin ---
XNR iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={lmir} w={wnr} nf=4

* --- pbias generator: nbias copy loads PMOS diode, 25 uA ---
XNP pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={lmir} w={wnr} nf=4
XPP pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={lmir} w={wpp} nf=2

* --- 50 uA output current sources (always conducting) ---
XPU pgp pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={lmir} w={wpu} nf=4
XND ngp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={lmir} w={wnd} nf=8

* --- PMOS (UP) steering pair: to vout when up=1 (wrapper order d g s b) ---
XSPVO vout up_b pgp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w={wswp} nf=2
XSPVD pdum up   pgp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w={wswp} nf=2

* --- NMOS (DN) steering pair: to vout when dn=1 ---
XSNVO vout dn   ngp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w={wswn} nf=2
XSNVD ndum dn_b ngp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w={wswn} nf=2

* --- dummy terminators (50 uA), tuned near mid output voltage ---
XPDUM ndum ndum vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={lmir} w={wdtp} nf=2
XNDUM pdum pdum vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={lmir} w={wdtn} nf=8

* --- bias stiffening ---
CNB iref vss 1p
CPB pbias vss 1p

.ends pll_charge_pump

* Local inverter for control complement.
.subckt inv_cp in out vdd vss
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
.ends inv_cp

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* Current-steering PLL charge pump, 50 uA UP/DN from 25 uA iref.
* Topology:
*   iref -> diode NMOS (nbias = iref node), 25 uA
*   nbias replica NMOS in series with diode PMOS generates pbias, 25 uA
*   UP  : PMOS 2x current source -> PMOS steering pair (vout / NMOS-diode dummy)
*   DN  : NMOS 2x current sink <- NMOS steering pair (vout / PMOS-diode dummy)
*   Inverters provide complementary steering-gate drives.

.subckt cp_inv a y vdd vss
XNI y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XPI y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
.ends cp_inv

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout
* --- 25 uA reference: diode NMOS, nbias is the iref node ---
XNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=20 nf=4
* --- pbias generator: nbias NMOS replica in series with diode PMOS ---
XMNG  pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=20 nf=4
XMPG  pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=168 nf=24

* --- UP branch: PMOS 50 uA source with PMOS steering pair ---
XMPU  upx pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=336 nf=48
XSUP  vout upb upx vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=5
XSUPD pdum up  upx vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=5
XNPD  pdum pdum vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=40 nf=8

* --- DN branch: NMOS 50 uA sink with NMOS steering pair ---
XMND  dnx iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=40 nf=8
XSDN  vout dn  dnx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=5
XSDND ndum dnb dnx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=5
XPPD  ndum ndum vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=336 nf=48

* --- complementary steering-gate drives ---
XIU up upb vdd vss cp_inv
XID dn dnb vdd vss cp_inv
.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: current-steering, single 25uA reference input.
* up  -> sources 50uA into vout (PMOS steering pair)
* dn  -> sinks 50uA from vout (NMOS steering pair)
* Tails always flow (idle current steers into dummy loads), so switching
* only toggles steering-pair gates -> fast edges.
* Both halves use low-Vth (LVT) long-L mirrors for high r_o / low Pelgrom
* mismatch, with wide-swing GATED CASCODE steering switches. The switch ON
* gates are driven to analog cascode biases (vcas ~ Vth_n+2Vov for NMOS,
* pcas ~ VDD-Vth_p-2Vov for PMOS) generated by self-biased diode legs, so
* tail and switch both stay saturated across the 0.45-1.15V compliance
* range at all PVT corners (flatness + matching) and the cascodes shield
* the tails from vout. Level-shifters drive the switch gates between the
* cascode bias and the rail. A weak startup diode bootstraps vcas.

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ---- internal digital complements ----
XINVU_UP upb up vss vdd inv_1p8
XINVU_DN dnb dn vss vdd inv_1p8

* ---- NMOS LVT current reference: 25u diode at iref (external IREF) ----
XNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=6 w=36 nf=6
* 25u LVT leg feeding the PMOS reference diode -- cascoded (gate vcas) so
* the PMOS reference current is insensitive to VDD.
XNPT  n1  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=6 w=36 nf=6
XNPC  gp  vcas n1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=48 nf=8
* weak startup diode (vdd->vcas): on if vcas=0 (latched), ~sub-uA at bias.
XSU   vcas vcas vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=0.5 nf=1

* ---- PMOS LVT current reference: 25u diode at gp (gate=drain), fed above ----
XPREF gp  gp  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=6 w=120 nf=6

* ---- cascode bias generators ----
* NMOS cascode bias vcas = Vth_n + 2Vov : 25u LVT-PMOS leg -> LVT-N diode
XPCASN vcas gp  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=6 w=120 nf=6
XNCAS  vcas vcas vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=6 w=6  nf=1
* PMOS cascode bias pcas = vdd - Vth_p - 2Vov : 25u LVT-NMOS leg -> LVT-P diode
XNCASP pcas iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=6 w=36 nf=6
XPCASD pcas pcas vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=6 w=30 nf=3

* ---- output tails: 50u each ----
XNSNK pn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=6 w=74 nf=12
XPSRC sp  gp   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=6 w=248 nf=18

* ---- NMOS steering pair (sink): LVT gated cascodes, ON gate = vcas ----
*   dn=1 -> XNO on (sink vout); dn=0 -> XND on (steer tail to dummy)
XGNO  gn   dnb  vcas vss vdd drv_n
XGDM  gndm dn   vcas vss vdd drv_n
XNO   vout gn   pn   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=30 nf=6
XND   dumn gndm pn   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=30 nf=6

* ---- PMOS steering pair (source): LVT gated cascodes, ON gate = pcas ----
*   up=1 -> XPO on (source vout); up=0 -> XPD on (steer tail to dummy)
XGPO  gpo  up   pcas vss vdd drv_p
XGPD  gpd  upb  pcas vss vdd drv_p
XPO   sp  gpo  vout vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=64 nf=8
XPD   sp  gpd  dump vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=64 nf=8

* ---- Dummy load legs (absorb idle tail currents; match the active legs) ----
XNDP  dump iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=6 w=74 nf=12
XPDN  dumn gp  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=6 w=248 nf=18

* ---- bias stiffening ----
CBIASN iref vss 2p
CBIASP vdd  gp  1p
CBIASC vcas vss 1p
CBIAS2 vdd  pcas 1p

.ends pll_charge_pump

* 1.8 V CMOS inverter: out in vss vdd
.subckt inv_1p8 out in vss vdd
XP vdd in  out  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
XN out in vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
.ends inv_1p8

* Level-shifting driver: output swings vss..vcas (NMOS cascode gates)
* in=vss -> out=vcas (ON) ; in=vdd -> out=vss (OFF)
.subckt drv_n out in vcas vss vdd
XP vcas in out vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
XN out  in vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8  nf=2
.ends drv_n

* Level-shifting driver: output swings pcas..vdd (PMOS cascode gates)
* in=vdd -> out=pcas (ON) ; in=vss -> out=vdd (OFF)
.subckt drv_p out in pcas vss vdd
XP vdd  in out vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
XN out  in pcas vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8  nf=2
.ends drv_p

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: current-steering, single external iref (25u -> 50u UP/DN).
* Wide-swing cascoded current sources for compliance flatness; transmission-gate
* steering switches for full-range vout conduction; always-on current sources with
* dummy loads for fast current-steering switching.
.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ---- Bias generator (iref = NMOS diode, 25u) ----
* Vg_n = iref (NMOS reference diode, 25u)
XMNA iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=8 nf=20
* NMOS sink (1:1) for the PMOS reference diode
XMNB Vgp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=8 nf=20
* Vg_p = Vgp (PMOS reference diode, 25u)
XMPA Vgp Vgp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=200 l=8 nf=40
* PMOS source (1:1) feeding the Vb_n diode
XMPBN Vbn Vgp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=200 l=8 nf=40
* Vb_n diode (25u, W/L=3.125 -> Vdsat=2x source Vdsat -> wide-swing NMOS cascode bias)
XMVBN Vbn Vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=6.25 l=4 nf=1
* NMOS sink (1:1) pulling the Vb_p diode
XMNBP Vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=8 nf=20
* Vb_p diode (25u, W/L=6.25 -> wide-swing PMOS cascode bias)
XMVBP Vbp Vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=12.5 l=4 nf=2

* ---- DN branch: NMOS cascoded current sink, 50u (2x ref) ----
XMSRCN casn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=200 l=8 nf=40
XMCASN nsum Vbn casn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=4 nf=20
* steering TG to vout (active when dn high)
XMSWDNN vout dn nsum vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.15 nf=2
XMSWDNP nsum dnb vout vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.15 nf=2
* dummy to vdd (active when dn low -> keeps sink running off-state)
XMDUMDNP nsum dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=4

* ---- UP branch: PMOS cascoded current source, 50u (2x ref) ----
XMSRCP casp Vgp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=400 l=8 nf=80
XMCASP psum Vbp casp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=200 l=4 nf=40
* steering TG to vout (active when up high -> upb low)
XMSWUPP vout upb psum vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.15 nf=2
XMSWUPN psum up vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.15 nf=2
* dummy to vss (active when up low -> keeps source running off-state)
XMDUMUPN psum upb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=4

* ---- control-signal inverters (generate upb, dnb complements) ----
XMPINV1 upb up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=2
XMNINV1 upb up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XMPINV2 dnb dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=2

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: current-steering, 50uA matched UP/DN from 25uA iref.
* Topology: 2:1 mirrors (PMOS->UP source, NMOS->DN sink) kept always
* biased; current is steered by switching the CASCODE gate between the
* wide-swing bias voltage (on) and the rail (off).  A twin dummy cascode
* carries the 50uA whenever the vout cascode is off, so the mirror drain
* (upint/dnint) -- the big, high-capacitance node -- never moves.  vout
* therefore sees only the small cascode-drain capacitance, and the gate
* feedthrough injected at the ON edge is returned at the OFF edge, so it
* cancels inside the bench's symmetric charge-integration windows.
* Pin order: vss iref up dn vdd vout

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* ===== Reference bias (Vn at iref, Vp at nref2) =====
XMNdi   iref  iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=60   nf=1
XMNref1 nref2 iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=60   nf=1
XMPdi   nref2 nref2 vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=165  nf=1

* ===== Wide-swing cascode bias (10uA Sooch replicas) =====
* Vcas_n = Vthn + 2*Vovn  ; Vcas_p = Vdd - |Vthp| - 2*Vovp
XMP10n  vcasn nref2 vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=66   nf=1
XMNAn   vcasn vcasn midn vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=24   nf=1
XMNBn   midn  iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=24   nf=1
XMN10p  vcasp iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=24   nf=1
XMPAp   vcasp vcasp midp vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=66   nf=1
XMPBp   midp  nref2 vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=66   nf=1

* ===== UP current source (sources into vout when up=high) =====
XMPup   upint  nref2 vdd    vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=338 nf=1
* vout cascode (on when up=high) and dummy cascode (on when up=low)
XMPcupv vout   upcasv upint vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=100 nf=1
XMPcupd updummy upcasd upint vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=100 nf=1
* dummy sink for the UP 50uA when steered away from vout
XMNduk  updummy iref  vss    vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=120 nf=1
* cascode-gate mux: upcasv = vcasp (up=1) / vdd (up=0)
XMNsv   vcasp  up    upcasv vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=1
XMPsv   upcasv up    vdd    vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=1
* upcasd = vcasp (up=0) / vdd (up=1)
XMNsd   vcasp  upb   upcasd vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=1
XMPsd   upcasd upb   vdd    vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=1

* ===== DN current sink (sinks from vout when dn=high) =====
XMNdn   dnint  iref  vss     vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=120 nf=1
XMNcdnv vout   dncasv dnint  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=60  nf=1
XMNcdnd dndummy dncasd dnint vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=60  nf=1
XMPdus  dndummy nref2 vdd    vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=338 nf=1
* dncasv = vcasn (dn=1) / vss (dn=0)
XMPnv   dncasv dnb   vcasn  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=1
XMNnv   vss    dnb   dncasv vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=1
* dncasd = vcasn (dn=0) / vss (dn=1)
XMPnd   dncasd dn    vcasn  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=1
XMNnd   vss    dn    dncasd vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=1

* ===== Inverters for steering complements =====
XMPinvu upb up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XMNinvu upb up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XMPinvd dnb dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XMNinvd dnb dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1

* ===== Stiffening caps on bias / cascode-gate nodes =====
Cnref2 nref2 vss 200f
Cvcasn vcasn vss 200f
Cvcasp vcasp vss 200f

.ends pll_charge_pump

XMP_PU n1 up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

XMN1 ndn n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6.25 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: 50 uA matched UP/DN from one 25 uA reference input.
* iref is the only analog bias input; up/dn are digital controls.
* Only SKY130 MOS devices are used (no R/L/sources/behavioral elements).
.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout
* Reference: iref forces 25 uA through the diode-connected MNREF;
* Vbn = v(iref) biases the NMOS current mirror.
XMNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=30 nf=1
* Bias stack: MP1 is diode-connected and sets BP; MN1 mirrors MNREF
* so the stack draws exactly the iref current from vdd.
XMP1 bp bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=30 nf=1
XMN1 bp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=30 nf=1
* Output current sources: 2x reference => 50 uA nominal per branch.
XMPCS a_up bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=1
XMNCS a_dn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=1
* Active-high steering switches. Bulk tied to vdd keeps every source/drain
* junction reverse-biased over the full compliance range, minimizing off
* leakage; the current sources stay saturated, giving flat DC output.
XSWUP a_up up vout vdd sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=1
XSWDN vout dn a_dn vdd sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=1
.ends pll_charge_pump

* 25 uA reference into iref; up/dn are digital controls

* DN path: NMOS switch + cascode mirror

* NMOS diode sets Vbn from iref current
XM1 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* PMOS diode biased by NMOS mirror -> sets Vbp
XM2 vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
XM3 vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* --- NMOS cascode bias ---
XM_ncas_src vbn_cas vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
XM_ncas_ref vbn_cas vbn_cas vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 nf=1

XM_pcas_snk vbp_cas iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XM_pcas_ref vbp_cas vbp_cas vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.66 nf=1

Cbp vbp_cas vss 1p

XM4 node_up vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=18 nf=8
* PMOS cascode/switch: drain->vout, gate controlled by UP

XM_pullup vbp_cas_sw up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=6

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: matched 50 uA UP / -50 uA DN current steering.
* iref: 25 uA reference input. up/dn: digital controls (0/1.8 V).
* Model library and process corner are loaded by the testbench.
*
* Architecture:
*   NMOS diode M1 converts iref to a gate bias (vbias_n = iref node).
*   M3 mirrors 25 uA into node nref; PMOS diode MP1 closes the KCL loop,
*   forcing exactly 25 uA in MP1 and establishing vbias_p = nref.
*   MP2/MN2 (2x ratio) produce the 50 uA output current source/sink;
*   cascodes MP3/MN3 give high output impedance for compliance flatness.
*   Cascode bias rails cbias_p/cbias_n are self-biased series diode strings
*   whose threshold terms track the output devices across PVT.
*   Output switches are overdriven stacked MOS switches driven by up/dn
*   (up_bar comes from a small CMOS inverter); switch nodes track vout so
*   turn-off is fast and off-state leakage is stacked low.
.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout
* -------- 25 uA reference (NMOS domain) --------
XM1 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=10 nf=1
XM3 nref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=10 nf=1
* -------- PMOS reference diode: forces MP1 current = M3 current = 25 uA --------
XMP1 nref nref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=10 nf=1
* -------- UP 50 uA current source + cascode --------
XMP2 cp nref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=60 nf=1
XMP3 sup cbias_p cp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=60 nf=1
* -------- DN 50 uA current sink + cascode --------
XMN2 dnsd iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=60 nf=1
XMN3 sdn cbias_n dnsd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=60 nf=1
* -------- cascode bias rails: series self-biased diode strings --------
XMPx cbias_p cbias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=0.8 nf=1
XMNy cbias_p cbias_p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1.0 nf=1
XMPy cbias_n cbias_n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1.0 nf=1
XMNy2 cbias_n cbias_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1.0 nf=1
* -------- up_bar inverter (CMOS, MOS only) --------
XIPI upb up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=1
XINI upb up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
* -------- output switches (stacked for leakage, overdriven for speed) --------
XSWPA midp upb sup vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=1
XSWPB vout upb midp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=1
XSWNA midn dn sdn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=1
XSWNB vout dn midn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=1
.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: 25uA reference in, matched +/-50uA UP/DN steering.
*
* Architecture (current steering, both mirrors always biased):
*  - iref sinks 25uA through diode XN0 -> nbias node (iref pin).
*  - XNB (cascoded by XNCB, bias from the XPTP/XND1/XNBI leg) mirrors XN0
*    and sinks the 25uA of diode XP0, generating pbias = vdd - |Vgs_XP0|.
*  - P devices are intentionally wide so |Vgs_XP0| ~ 0.9V: low overdrive keeps
*    the UP mirror saturated down to vdd=1.62V at vout=1.15V.
*  - UP branch: XP1 (2x XP0) source, steered by PMOS switch XPSW driven from
*    inverted "up".
*  - DN branch: wide diode XNDW (fed by XP3) generates low-Vov nbias_w;
*    XN1 (2x XNDW) sink cascoded by XCAS (drain pinned by ncas for
*    flatness), steered by NMOS switch XNSW driven directly by "dn"
*    (fast turn-off, no inversion needed).
*  - ncas bias: XP2 (1x P mirror) forces ~25uA through small diode XND2.
*  - Reference and mirror devices share identical channel length so that
*    length-dependent threshold shifts track.

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* --- N-side reference: iref pin is the nbias diode node -----------------
XN0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=210 nf=30 m=1

* --- Cascode-bias leg: s1 ~= Vds_XNB + Vgs (reference for XNCB) ---------
XPTP vdd vss s1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2 m=1
XND1 s1 s1 s2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=210 nf=30 m=1
XNBI s2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=210 nf=30 m=1

* --- Nb mirror of XN0, cascoded, sinks XP0 current -----------------------
XNB nb_d iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=210 nf=30 m=1
XNCB pb s1 nb_d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2 m=1

* --- P-side reference diode (wide): pbias = vdd - |Vgs_XP0| ~ vdd - 0.9 --

circuit:
* PLL Charge Pump - v2
* 50 uA matched UP/DN, single iref=25uA reference

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias references
* NMOS reference diode: sinks iref -> Vbn (tracks iref, DN main gate)
XMn_ref iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
* PMOS reference diode branch (self-biased vdd->vss) -> Vbp (UP main gate)
XMp_ref vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=1
XMn_bias vbp vbp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
* Cascode bias voltages (self-biased branches)
XMbp_c vbp_c vbp_c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XMn_c  vbp_c vbp_c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XMbnc  vbn_c vbn_c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XMbn_c vbn_c vbn_c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1

* UP branch: PMOS current source (source at vdd) + cascode + switch
XMup_main y_up vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=1
XMup_casc vout g_up y_up vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
Xup_pullup g_up up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
Xup_pass   g_up up vbp_c vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* DN branch: NMOS current sink (source at vss) + cascode + switch
XMdn_main y_dn vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=1
XMdn_casc vout g_dn y_dn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: current-steering, single external 25uA reference.
*
* Mirror families (all l=8 so geometry Vth factors cancel within a family):
*   N1  = nfet_01v8      l=8 w=62  nf=13  (25 uA at Vgs=bias_n)   N mains
*   N4  = nfet_01v8      l=8 w=248 nf=52  (4x N1, low Vov)        N cascodes
*   P1L = pfet_01v8_lvt  l=8 w=400 nf=80  (25 uA at |Vgs|=bias_p) P mains
*   P4L = pfet_01v8_lvt  l=8 w=800 nf=160 (2x P1L, low Vov)       P cascodes
* The l=8 devices have a soft Id(Vds) knee on an absolute-voltage scale,
* so cascode biases are generated to hold ~0.3 V of drain margin on every
* main. The low-|Vth| LVT pfets keep that margin affordable at 1.62 V:
* a standard pfet diode would eat the whole supply at the slow/cold corner.
* 50 uA branches use two mains in parallel (2:1 vs the reference main).
*
* Bias generation:
*  - iref sinks 25u through N1 diode XMNR -> bias_n on node iref.
*  - XMNP mirrors XMNR (25u) into P1L diode XMPR -> bias_p on node bp.
*  - Cascode biases from density-scaled diode replicas:
*    bcasp = vdd - |Vgs|(QP) with Vov_qp > Vov_p4l -> px = vdd-(Vgs_qp-Vgs_p4l)
*    bcasn = Vgs(QN)         with Vov_qn > Vov_n4  -> ny = Vov_qn - Vov_n4
*
* Signal path:
*  - DN: vout -> NMOS switch XMNSW (gate=dn, direct drive) -> N4 cascode
*    pair -> two N1 mains -> vss.
*  - UP: vdd -> two P1L mains -> P4L cascode pair -> PMOS switch XMPSW
*    (gate=upb) -> vout; upb from a local inverter keeps full switch
*    overdrive at every supply corner.
.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* --- Bias: NMOS diode from iref, PMOS diode from mirrored branch ----
XMNR  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=62 nf=13
XMNP  bp   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=62 nf=13
XMPR  bp   bp   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=400 nf=80

* --- Cascode bias replicas (density-scaled diodes) -------------------
XMQP  bcasp bcasp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=60 nf=12
XMNSQ bcasp iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=62 nf=13
XMPF  bcasn bp    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=400 nf=80
XMQN  bcasn bcasn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=7 nf=2

* --- Cascoded reference pair (25 uA) --------------------------------
XMPR2 pxr   bp    vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=400 nf=80
XMPRC nrtop bcasp pxr  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=800 nf=160
XMNRC nrtop bcasn nyr  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=248 nf=52
XMNR2 nyr   iref  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=62 nf=13

* --- DN branch: vout -> switch -> cascode sink -> vss ---------------
XMNSW vout dn   b    vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=5
XMNC1 b    bcasn ny   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=248 nf=52
XMNC2 b    bcasn ny   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=248 nf=52
XMN31 ny   iref  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=62 nf=13
XMN32 ny   iref  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=62 nf=13

* --- UP branch: vdd -> cascode source -> switch -> vout -------------
XMPM1 px   bp    vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=400 nf=80
XMPM2 px   bp    vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=400 nf=80
XMPC1 a    bcasp px   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=800 nf=160
XMPC2 a    bcasp px   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=800 nf=160
XMPSW vout upb   a    vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=5

* --- Control inverter for the UP PMOS switch ------------------------
XMNI upb up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMPI upb up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2

.ends pll_charge_pump

taskTitle: Design a PLL Charge Pump: 50 uA Matched UP/DN Current
circuit:
* PLL charge pump: current-steering, single external reference current.
* iref sinks 25 uA; up/dn command +/-50 uA at vout.
*
* Bias chain:
*   XNR2/XNR1 diode stack sinks iref -> nb1 = Vgsn, iref node = 2*Vgsn.
*   XFX1/XFX2: cascoded 1:1 NMOS feed; XFX2 (gate = iref node) clamps the
*   feed drain to nb1 so XFX1 Vds matches XNR1 exactly.
*   XPR1: pfet_lvt diode (50 uA: 25 uA feed + 25 uA cascode-bias branch).
*   UP cascode gate: vb2p = pt1 - 25u*RUP. With XUP1/XUP2 sized as below,
*   u1 = vdd - Vds_p1 - dV + Vds_c, so XUP1 keeps Vds = Vds_p1+dV-Vds_c
*   and a can swing to within Vds_p1+dV of vdd at every corner.
*   DN cascode gate: nb3 = Vgs of XNR3 (diode, source at vss, no body
*   effect), giving d1 = Vdsat3 - Vds_c - body ~= 1.05*Vdsat_unit.
* Output branches (cascode-shielded so mirror gates see quiet nodes):
*   XUP1/XUP2 source 50 uA toward node a; XDN/XDC sink 50 uA from node b.
*   XUP2 bulk is tied to u1 (own n-well) to kill its body effect.
* Switches:
*   Transmission gates (XMU/XPU for UP, XMD/XPD for DN). NMOS gates driven
*   directly by up/dn (early cutoff); PMOS gates by local inverters.

.subckt pll_charge_pump vss iref up dn vdd vout

* --- NMOS reference stack (sinks iref = 25 uA), unit l=4 w=140
XNR2 iref iref nb1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=140 nf=28
XNR1 nb1 nb1 vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=140 nf=28

* --- Cascoded 1:1 NMOS feed for the PMOS reference diode
XFX1 fx1 nb1  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=140 nf=28
XFX2 pt1 iref fx1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=140 nf=28

* --- PMOS (lvt) reference diode, 50 uA (feed + cascode bias branch)
XPR1 pt1 pt1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=740 nf=148

* --- UP cascode bias: vb2p = pt1 - 25u*RUP; XBS2 sinks the branch current
XRUP pt1 vb2p vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=2 l=5
XBS2 vb2p nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=140 nf=28

* --- 1:2 UP current source, cascoded (XUP2 bulk = u1, own well)
XUP1A u1 pt1  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=515 nf=103
XUP1B u1 pt1  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=515 nf=103
XUP2A a  vb2p u1   u1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=695 nf=139
XUP2B a  vb2p u1   u1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=695 nf=139
XUP2C a  vb2p u1   u1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=695 nf=139
XUP2D a  vb2p u1   u1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=695 nf=139
XUP2E a  vb2p u1   u1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=695 nf=139

* --- DN cascode gate bias: nb3 = Vgs of a 0.267-Vdsat diode (25 uA)
XPX  nb3 pt1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=370 nf=74
XNR3 nb3 nb3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8    l=4 w=43  nf=8

* --- 1:2 DN current sink, cascoded
XDN d1 nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=280 nf=56
XDC b  nb3 d1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=925 nf=185

* --- Control inverters (drive the PMOS switch gates)
XINU  up_bar up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XINVP up_bar up vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XIND  dn_bar dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XINDP dn_bar dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=4

* --- Output transmission-gate switches
XMU a    up     vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=20 nf=4
XPU a    up_bar vout vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=8
XMD vout dn     b    vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=20 nf=4
XPD vout dn_bar b    vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=8

.ends pll_charge_pump
